questions.full:
Barred owls can be found in dense forests right across North America.
They feed on small ______ ,fish, birds and small reptiles - pretty much anything that comes their way.

mammals , adaptable , urban , native

答案:

2. adaptable

sense_groups.english: Barred owls can be found in dense forests right across North America.
sense_groups.chinese: 横斑林鸮遍布北美各地的茂密森林。

sense_groups.english: They feed on small mammals, fish, birds and small reptiles - pretty much anything that comes their way.
sense_groups.chinese: 它们以小型哺乳动物、鱼类、鸟类和小型爬行动物为食——几乎任何遇到的东西都吃。

sense_groups.english: The barred owl grows up to half a metre tall and has emerged as a very adaptable nocturnal predator.
sense_groups.chinese: 横斑林鸮能长到半米高，已成为一种适应性极强的夜间捕食者。

sense_groups.english: Whereas they have been long-thought to live in old-growth forests, they are now building up quite an urban population.
sense_groups.chinese: 尽管人们长期以来认为它们生活在原始森林中，但现在它们正在建立起相当可观的都市种群。

sense_groups.english: In Charlotte, North Carolina, barred owls tend to nest in the cavities of the numerous willow oak trees that line the city's streets.
sense_groups.chinese: 在北卡罗来纳州的夏洛特，横斑林鸮倾向于在街道两旁众多的柳橡树树洞中筑巢。

sense_groups.english: Far from being endangered, the owls have expanded their range; and now, in some places, conservationists are worried about the effects they might have on other native species.
sense_groups.chinese: 这些猫头鹰远未濒危，反而扩大了活动范围；如今，在某些地方，保护主义者担心它们可能对其他本地物种产生影响。

questions.name: #2 Pearl Oysters
questions.en:
Before the beginning of the 1900s, the only way to obtain pearls was by collecting very large numbers of pearl oysters from the ocean floor by hand.
The oysters - or sometimes mussels - were brought to the surface, opened, and ______ .
More than a ton of these had to be checked in order to find just three or four quality pearls.
Divers often descended to depths of over 100 feet on just one single breath.
Now, of course this exposed them to ______ creatures and dangerous waves, not to mention drowning.
In some areas, divers put grease on their bodies to conserve heat and they held a large ______ like a rock, to descend so they didn't have to exert effort going down.
Today, pearl diving has pretty much been supplanted by cultured pearl ______ .
Particles are implanted in the oyster to encourage the formation of pearls, and this allows for more predictable production.
The divers who still work, do so mainly for the ______ industry.
searched , hostile , object , farms , tourist
questions.full:

sense_groups.english: Before the beginning of the 1900s,
sense_groups.chinese: 在20世纪初之前，

sense_groups.english: the only way to obtain pearls
sense_groups.chinese: 获得珍珠的唯一方法

sense_groups.english: was by collecting very large numbers of pearl oysters
sense_groups.chinese: 是收集大量的珍珠牡蛎

sense_groups.english: from the ocean floor by hand.
sense_groups.chinese: 从海底用手采集。

sense_groups.english: The oysters - or sometimes mussels -
sense_groups.chinese: 这些牡蛎——有时是贻贝——

sense_groups.english: were brought to the surface, opened, and searched.
sense_groups.chinese: 被带到水面，打开，然后搜寻。

sense_groups.english: More than a ton of these had to be checked

sense_groups.english: in order to find just three or four quality pearls.

sense_groups.english: Divers often descended to depths of over 100 feet

sense_groups.english: on just one single breath.
sense_groups.chinese: 仅凭一口气。

sense_groups.english: Now, of course this exposed them

sense_groups.chinese: 更不用说溺水了。

sense_groups.english: In some areas, divers put grease on their bodies
sense_groups.chinese: 在一些地区，潜水员在身上涂油脂

sense_groups.english: to conserve heat
sense_groups.chinese: 以保持体温

sense_groups.english: and they held a large object like a rock,

sense_groups.english: by cultured pearl farms.
sense_groups.chinese: 由养殖珍珠农场。

sense_groups.english: Particles are implanted in the oyster
sense_groups.chinese: 将颗粒植入牡蛎中

sense_groups.english: to encourage the formation of pearls,
sense_groups.chinese: 以促进珍珠的形成，

sense_groups.english: and this allows for more predictable production.
sense_groups.chinese: 这使得生产更加可预测。

sense_groups.english: The divers who still work, do so mainly
sense_groups.chinese: 仍然工作的潜水员，主要是为了

sense_groups.english: for the tourist industry.

questions.en:

questions.full:

Second, it acts as a barometer of world metal prices.

答案:

2. influence
3. manufacture
4. quantities

sense_groups.english: Almost everyone has heard of the London Stock Exchange, but relatively few know anything about the London Metal and Commodity Exchanges
sense_groups.chinese: 几乎每个人都听说过伦敦证券交易所，但相对很少有人了解伦敦金属和商品交易所

sense_groups.english: yet these markets have a greater influence on world economies

sense_groups.english: because they set global prices for some of the essential raw materials for industry and food manufacture
sense_groups.chinese: 因为它们为工业和食品制造的一些基本原材料设定了全球价格

sense_groups.english: The LME provides three basic services to the world's non-ferrous metal trade.
sense_groups.chinese: 伦敦金属交易所为全球有色金属贸易提供三项基本服务。

sense_groups.english: First, it is a market where large or small quantities of metal of a guaranteed minimum standard can be bought and sold on specific trading days.
sense_groups.chinese: 首先，它是一个市场，在特定的交易日可以买卖大量或小量的、保证最低标准的金属。

sense_groups.english: Second, it acts as a barometer of world metal prices.
sense_groups.chinese: 其次，它是世界金属价格的晴雨表。

sense_groups.english: And third, it is a hedging medium: that is, it can help traders get some protection from price fluctuations that occur for economic, political or financial reasons.
sense_groups.chinese: 第三，它是一种对冲工具：也就是说，它可以帮助交易者获得一些保护，免受因经济、政治或金融原因而发生的价格波动的影响。

questions.name: #4 FIB-L

questions.full:

sense_groups.english: An important question about education is, then, why do some types of students achieve success easily and others struggle to do well?
sense_groups.chinese: 那么，教育中的一个重要问题是，为什么有些类型的学生能轻松取得成功，而另一些学生却难以取得好成绩？

sense_groups.english: Well, one theory is that there is a genetic reason for academic achievement.

sense_groups.english: What I mean by that is, a certain innate, measurable level of intelligence.
sense_groups.chinese: 我的意思是，某种天生的、可测量的智力水平。

sense_groups.english: Another frequently discussed theory is environmental factors, such as the effect of home and family upbringing.
sense_groups.chinese: 另一个经常讨论的理论是环境因素，比如家庭和家庭教育的影响。

sense_groups.english: A final reason is related to the teaching and learning process within educational institutions, and the way it is organized, administered and assessed.
sense_groups.chinese: 最后一个原因与教育机构内的教与学过程及其组织、管理和评估方式有关。

sense_groups.english: Learning a language in the classroom is never easy

questions.name: #20 Too Much Information
questions.en:
There is such a thing as information ______ .

There is a similar thing going on with the range of choices we have as ______ .
There is so much stuff out there, so much to choose from, that, according to some experts, this situation is making us ______ .

questions.answer:

3. discard
4. consumers

6. tract

sense_groups.english: There is such a thing as information overload .
sense_groups.chinese: 有一种现象叫做信息过载。

sense_groups.english: There is a similar thing going on with the range of choices we have as consumers .
sense_groups.chinese: 作为消费者，我们面临的选择范围也出现了类似的情况。

questions.en:
Post-modernism is broadly speaking a ______ against the movement or the period, or perhaps simply the values and beliefs of, modernism.

sense_groups.english: Post-modernism is broadly speaking a reaction against the movement or the period, or perhaps simply the values and beliefs of, modernism.
sense_groups.chinese: 后现代主义广义上是对现代主义运动、时期，或仅仅是其价值观和信仰的一种反抗。

sense_groups.english: Most people, even those who seem to know what it is or was about, tend to define it in negative terms by telling us what it isn't, or doesn't do.
sense_groups.chinese: 大多数人，甚至那些似乎了解它是什么或曾经是什么的人，往往用否定性的术语来定义它，告诉我们它不是什么，或者它不做什么。

sense_groups.english: Initially the term had a fairly limited application and referred to a new anti-modernist style of architecture.
sense_groups.chinese: 最初，这个术语的应用相当有限，指的是一种新的反现代主义建筑风格。

sense_groups.english: But it spread like a virus to include almost all aspects of contemporary culture.
sense_groups.chinese: 但它像病毒一样传播开来，几乎涵盖了当代文化的所有方面。

sense_groups.english: One thing we can be sure about is that it wanted to get rid of what were called the grand narratives by which we explained how the world - and history - got us from the past to the present.

sense_groups.english: Another feature of post-modernism is its belief that truth and reality are human-centered and internal .
sense_groups.chinese: 后现代主义的另一个特征是相信真理和现实是以人为中心的、内在的。

sense_groups.english: That is, the primary source of truth in the present age is the self.
sense_groups.chinese: 也就是说，当今时代真理的主要来源是自我。

sense_groups.english: This, I believe, has now all passed and been thrown in the rubbish bin of history.

sense_groups.english: Yet it is difficult to know whether the age of information technology confirms the passing of post-modernism or is a consequence of it.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，很难知道信息技术时代是证实了后现代主义的消亡，还是其后果。

questions.en: A Harvard economist's idea — giving free cellphone air time to high-performing students as an (incentive) to continue doing well — is now in effect. Schools Chancellor Joel I. Klein today started the Million Motivation Campaign, an experimental program involving about 2,500 students in seven middle schools. The students will each receive a free cellphone, called the "Million," with (opportunities) to earn minutes and other rewards if they achieve academic goals set by their principals. Teachers and (administrators) will also be able to use the cellphones to communicate with the students. sense_groups.english: After years of fretting over coming shortages, the country is actually facing a dwindling number of young people entering engineering and technology-related fields.
sense_groups.chinese: 在多年担忧即将到来的短缺之后，这个国家实际上正面临进入工程和技术相关领域的年轻人数量不断减少的情况。

sense_groups.english: The decline is growing so drastic that industry has begun advertising campaigns intended to make engineering look sexy and cool, and companies are slowly starting to import foreign workers, or sending jobs to where the engineers are, in Vietnam and India.
sense_groups.chinese: 这种下降变得如此剧烈，以至于行业开始发起广告宣传活动，旨在让工程学看起来性感又酷炫，公司也开始慢慢引进外国工人，或者将工作外包给工程师所在的地方，比如越南和印度。

sense_groups.english: It was engineering prowess that lifted this nation from postwar defeat to economic superpower.
sense_groups.chinese: 正是工程学的实力将这个国家从战败国提升为经济超级大国。

sense_groups.english: But according to educators, executives and young Japanese themselves, the young here are behaving more like Americans: choosing better-paying fields like finance and medicine, or more purely creative careers, like the arts, rather than following their salaryman fathers into the unglamorous world of manufacturing.
sense_groups.chinese: 但根据教育工作者、高管和日本年轻人自己的说法，这里的年轻人行为更像美国人：选择金融和医学等高薪领域，或者艺术等更纯粹的创造性职业，而不是追随他们工薪阶层的父亲进入平淡无奇的制造业世界。

sense_groups.english: The problem did not catch Japan by surprise.
sense_groups.chinese: 这个问题并没有让日本感到意外。

sense_groups.english: The first signs of declining interest among the young in science and engineering appeared almost two decades ago, after Japan reached first-world living standards, and in recent years there has been a steady decline in the number of science and engineering students.
sense_groups.chinese: 年轻人对科学和工程兴趣下降的最初迹象出现在大约二十年前，在日本达到第一世界生活水平之后，近年来理工科学生数量持续下降。

sense_groups.english: But only now are Japanese companies starting to feel the real pinch.
sense_groups.chinese: 但直到现在，日本公司才开始感受到真正的压力。

sense_groups.english: By one ministry of international affairs estimate, the digital technology industry here is already short almost half a million engineers.
sense_groups.chinese: 根据一个国际事务部的估计，这里的数字技术行业已经短缺近50万名工程师。

sense_groups.english: Headhunters have begun poaching engineers midcareer with fat signing bonuses, a predatory practice once unheard-of in Japan's less-cutthroat version of capitalism.
sense_groups.chinese: 猎头开始用丰厚的签约奖金挖走职业生涯中期的工程师，这种掠夺性做法在日本不那么残酷的资本主义版本中曾经闻所未闻。

sense_groups.english: The problem is likely to worsen because Japan has one of the lowest birthrates in the world.
sense_groups.chinese: 由于日本是世界上出生率最低的国家之一，这个问题可能会恶化。

sense_groups.english: "Japan is sitting on a demographic time bomb," said Kazuhiro Asakawa, a professor of business at Keio University.
sense_groups.chinese: “日本正坐在一颗人口定时炸弹上，”庆应义塾大学商学教授浅川和宏说。

sense_groups.english: "An explosion is going to take place.
sense_groups.chinese: “爆炸即将发生。

sense_groups.english: They see it coming, but no one is doing enough about it."
sense_groups.chinese: 他们看到它来了，但没有人采取足够的行动。”

sense_groups.english: The holiday of Valentine's Day probably derives its origins from the ancient Roman feast of Lupercalia.
sense_groups.chinese: 情人节可能起源于古罗马的牧神节。

sense_groups.english: In the early days of Rome, fierce wolves roamed the woods nearby.
sense_groups.chinese: 在罗马早期，凶猛的狼在附近的树林里游荡。

sense_groups.english: The Romans called upon one of their gods, Lupercus, to keep the wolves away.
sense_groups.chinese: 罗马人祈求他们的神之一卢波库斯来驱赶狼群。

sense_groups.english: A festival held in honor of Lupercus was celebrated on February 15th.
sense_groups.chinese: 为纪念卢波库斯而举行的节日在2月15日庆祝。

sense_groups.english: The festival was celebrated as a spring festival.
sense_groups.chinese: 这个节日被当作春节来庆祝。

sense_groups.english: Their calendar was different at that time, with February falling in early springtime.
sense_groups.chinese: 当时的历法不同，二月正值早春。

sense_groups.english: One of the customs of the young people was name-drawing.
sense_groups.chinese: 年轻人的习俗之一是抽名字。

sense_groups.english: On the eve of the festival of Lupercalia the names of Roman girls were written on slips of paper and placed into jars.
sense_groups.chinese: 在牧神节前夕，罗马女孩的名字被写在纸条上放进罐子里。

sense_groups.english: Each young man drew a slip.
sense_groups.chinese: 每个年轻男子抽一张纸条。

sense_groups.english: The girl whose name was chosen was to be his sweetheart for the year.
sense_groups.chinese: 被选中的女孩将成为他那一年的恋人。

sense_groups.english: Legend has it that the holiday became Valentine's Day after a priest named Valentine.
sense_groups.chinese: 传说这个节日以一位名叫瓦伦丁的牧师的名字变成了情人节。

sense_groups.english: Valentine was a priest in Rome at the time Christianity was a new religion.
sense_groups.chinese: 瓦伦丁是罗马的一位牧师，当时基督教是一种新宗教。

sense_groups.english: The Emperor at that time, Claudius II, ordered the Roman soldiers NOT to marry or become engaged.
sense_groups.chinese: 当时的皇帝克劳狄二世命令罗马士兵不得结婚或订婚。

sense_groups.english: Claudius believed that as married men, his soldiers would want to stay home with their families rather than fight his wars.
sense_groups.chinese: 克劳狄认为，作为已婚男人，他的士兵会想和家人待在家里，而不是为他打仗。

sense_groups.english: Valentine defied the Emperor's decree and secretly married the young couples.
sense_groups.chinese: 瓦伦丁违抗皇帝的法令，秘密地为年轻情侣主持婚礼。

sense_groups.english: He was eventually arrested, imprisoned, and put to death.
sense_groups.chinese: 他最终被捕、入狱并被处死。

sense_groups.english: Valentine was beheaded on February 14th, the eve of the Roman holiday Lupercalia.
sense_groups.chinese: 瓦伦丁在2月14日被斩首，那天是罗马牧神节的前夕。

sense_groups.chinese: 再有一两天这样的行情，那些市场基准指数今年就会转为正值。

sense_groups.english: while consumers find themselves in a more precarious position
sense_groups.chinese: 而消费者发现自己处境更加危险，

sense_groups.english: as the job market weakens and banks make it harder to borrow money.

sense_groups.english: It is, of course, not uncommon for Wall Street to run ahead of the broader economy.

sense_groups.chinese: 要么，如果乐观派正确，整体经济将展现更强韧性，

sense_groups.chinese: 因为退税支票和低利率刺激了经济。

sense_groups.english: There have been false dawns before.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们表示，变化的催化剂是

sense_groups.english: was the Fed-arranged deal that sold a troubled investment bank, Bear Stearns,

sense_groups.chinese: 确保大型证券公司不会因信心危机而崩溃。

In years past, doctors were afraid to let heart ______ exercise.
When my father had a heart attack in 1968, he was kept ______ for six weeks.
Now, heart attack patients are in bed barely half a day before they are up and moving, Dr. Moffat said.
The core of cardiac rehab is a ______ exercise program to increase the ability of the heart to pump oxygen- and nutrient-rich blood more effectively throughout the body.

"Heart failure patients as old as 91 can increase their ______ consumption significantly," Dr. Moffat said.
Aerobic exercise lowers blood pressure in people with hypertension, and it improves peripheral ______ in people who develop cramping leg pains when they walk — a condition called intermittent claudication.
The treatment for it, in fact, is to walk a little farther each day.
In people who have had transient ischemic ______ , or ministrokes, "gradually increasing exercise improves blood flow to the brain and may diminish the risk of a full-blown stroke," Dr. Moffat said.
And ______ and strength exercises have been shown to improve endurance, walking speed and the ability to perform tasks of daily living up to six years after a stroke.
As Randi knows, ______ exercise cuts the risk of developing diabetes.
And for those with ______ , exercise improves glucose tolerance — less medication is needed to control blood sugar — and reduces the ______ of life-threatening complications.

4. endurance

6. oxygen

sense_groups.english: In years past, doctors were afraid to let heart patients exercise.
sense_groups.chinese: 过去，医生不敢让心脏病患者运动。

sense_groups.english: When my father had a heart attack in 1968, he was kept sedentary for six weeks.
sense_groups.chinese: 1968年我父亲心脏病发作时，他被要求卧床六周。

sense_groups.english: Now, heart attack patients are in bed barely half a day before they are up and moving, Dr. Moffat said.
sense_groups.chinese: 莫法特医生说，现在心脏病患者卧床不到半天就起来活动了。

sense_groups.english: The core of cardiac rehab is a progressive exercise program to increase the ability of the heart to pump oxygen- and nutrient-rich blood more effectively throughout the body.
sense_groups.chinese: 心脏康复的核心是渐进式运动计划，以增强心脏将富含氧气和营养的血液更有效地泵送到全身的能力。

sense_groups.english: The outcome is better endurance, greater ability to enjoy life and decreased mortality.
sense_groups.chinese: 结果是更好的耐力、更强的享受生活的能力以及更低的死亡率。

sense_groups.english: The same goes for patients with congestive heart failure.
sense_groups.chinese: 充血性心力衰竭患者也是如此。

sense_groups.english: "Heart failure patients as old as 91 can increase their oxygen consumption significantly," Dr. Moffat said.
sense_groups.chinese: 莫法特医生说：“91岁的心力衰竭患者也能显著增加耗氧量。”

sense_groups.english: Aerobic exercise lowers blood pressure in people with hypertension, and it improves peripheral circulation in people who develop cramping leg pains when they walk — a condition called intermittent claudication.
sense_groups.chinese: 有氧运动可降低高血压患者的血压，并改善行走时腿部抽筋疼痛（即间歇性跛行）患者的外周循环。

sense_groups.english: The treatment for it, in fact, is to walk a little farther each day.
sense_groups.chinese: 事实上，治疗方法就是每天多走一点路。

sense_groups.english: In people who have had transient ischemic attacks, or ministrokes, "gradually increasing exercise improves blood flow to the brain and may diminish the risk of a full-blown stroke," Dr. Moffat said.
sense_groups.chinese: 莫法特医生说，对于有过短暂性脑缺血发作或小中风的人，“逐渐增加运动可以改善大脑血流，并可能降低完全中风的风险。”

sense_groups.english: And aerobic and strength exercises have been shown to improve endurance, walking speed and the ability to perform tasks of daily living up to six years after a stroke.
sense_groups.chinese: 有氧和力量训练已被证明能改善中风后长达六年的耐力、步行速度和日常生活能力。

sense_groups.english: As Randi knows, moderate exercise cuts the risk of developing diabetes.
sense_groups.chinese: 正如兰迪所知，适度运动可降低患糖尿病的风险。

sense_groups.english: And for those with diabetes, exercise improves glucose tolerance — less medication is needed to control blood sugar — and reduces the risk of life-threatening complications.
sense_groups.chinese: 对于糖尿病患者，运动可改善糖耐量——控制血糖所需的药物更少——并降低危及生命的并发症风险。

sense_groups.chinese: 自工业革命以来，温室气体的比例显著增加。

sense_groups.english: Humans began burning fossil fuels, particularly coal, in a big way, to drive steam engines for industry, and generate electricity.
sense_groups.chinese: 人类开始大量燃烧化石燃料，特别是煤炭，用于驱动工业蒸汽机和发电。

sense_groups.english: In addition to escalating coal use after the Industrial Revolution, there came the widespread use of another fossil fuel, petroleum for transport.
sense_groups.chinese: 除了工业革命后煤炭使用量的增加，另一种化石燃料——石油，也被广泛用于交通运输。

sense_groups.english: At the beginning of the 20th century, annual global oil output was about 150 million barrels of oil; now, that amount is extracted globally in just two days.
sense_groups.chinese: 20世纪初，全球石油年产量约为1.5亿桶；而现在，全球仅需两天就能开采出这个数量。

sense_groups.english: Fossil fuels are classed as non-renewable sources of energy, formed from decayed plants and animals over hundreds of millions of years.
sense_groups.chinese: 化石燃料被归类为不可再生能源，由数百万年来腐烂的动植物形成。

sense_groups.english: Burning fossil fuels releases billions of tons of carbon dioxide that has been locked away in the Earth for millions of years.
sense_groups.chinese: 燃烧化石燃料释放出数十亿吨被锁在地球中数百万年的二氧化碳。

sense_groups.english: Humans are adding billions of tons of carbon dioxide to the atmosphere each year.
sense_groups.chinese: 人类每年向大气中增加数十亿吨二氧化碳。

sense_groups.english: And guess what? Carbon dioxide is a greenhouse gas.
sense_groups.chinese: 你猜怎么着？二氧化碳是一种温室气体。

sense_groups.english: The rate at which the planet is warming is possibly the biggest challenge to ever face humanity.
sense_groups.chinese: 地球变暖的速度可能是人类面临的最大挑战。

sense_groups.english: The impacts are likely to be devastating, we need to act decisively, and act now.
sense_groups.chinese: 其影响可能是毁灭性的，我们需要果断行动，立即行动。

sense_groups.english: A single web page cannot fully answer the question of what global warming is.
sense_groups.chinese: 一个网页无法完全回答全球变暖是什么的问题。

sense_groups.english: Following the links on this page will allow you to see how complex and serious the issue of global warming is.
sense_groups.chinese: 点击本页面的链接，你将看到全球变暖问题有多么复杂和严重。

sense_groups.english: So what is global warming? It is a disaster of our own making.
sense_groups.chinese: 那么什么是全球变暖？它是我们自己造成的灾难。

questions.name: #38 Thunderstorm
questions.en:
Three basic ingredients are required for a thunderstorm to form: moisture, rising unstable air, and a lifting ______ .
The sun heats the surface of the earth, which warms the air above it.
If this warm surface air is forced to rise, it will continue to rise as long as it weighs less and stays warmer than the air around it.
As the air rises, it ______ heat from the surface of the earth to the upper levels of the atmosphere.
The water vapor it contains begins to cool, releasing the heat, and it ______ into a cloud.
The cloud eventually grows upward into areas where the temperature is below freezing.
Some of the water vapor turns to ice and some of it turns into water droplets.
Both have electrical charges.
Ice particles usually have ______ charges, and rain droplets usually have negative charges.
When the charges build up enough, they are discharged in a bolt of ______ , which causes the sound waves we hear as thunder.
On the 7th February, 2008, thunderstorms ripped through the eastern parts of Australia.
Winds gusting over 90 km/hr brought down trees on houses, power lines and roads.
The city of Perth, Western Australia had its wettest February since 1992 when more than 40 mm of heavy rain fell and caused a 50-day ______ to end.

questions.answer:
1. mechanism
2. transfers
3. condenses
4. positive
5. lightning
6. drought

sense_groups.english: Three basic ingredients are required for a thunderstorm to form: moisture, rising unstable air, and a lifting mechanism .
sense_groups.chinese: 雷暴的形成需要三个基本要素：水分、上升的不稳定空气以及抬升机制。

sense_groups.english: The sun heats the surface of the earth, which warms the air above it.
sense_groups.chinese: 太阳加热地球表面，从而温暖了上方的空气。

sense_groups.english: If this warm surface air is forced to rise, it will continue to rise as long as it weighs less and stays warmer than the air around it.
sense_groups.chinese: 如果这种温暖的地表空气被迫上升，只要它比周围空气更轻、更暖，就会持续上升。

sense_groups.english: As the air rises, it transfers heat from the surface of the earth to the upper levels of the atmosphere.
sense_groups.chinese: 空气上升时，将热量从地球表面传递到大气高层。

sense_groups.english: The water vapor it contains begins to cool, releasing the heat, and it condenses into a cloud.
sense_groups.chinese: 其中所含的水蒸气开始冷却，释放热量，并凝结成云。

sense_groups.english: The cloud eventually grows upward into areas where the temperature is below freezing.
sense_groups.chinese: 云最终向上发展到温度低于冰点的区域。

sense_groups.english: Some of the water vapor turns to ice and some of it turns into water droplets.
sense_groups.chinese: 部分水蒸气变成冰，部分变成水滴。

sense_groups.english: Both have electrical charges.
sense_groups.chinese: 两者都带有电荷。

sense_groups.english: Ice particles usually have positive charges, and rain droplets usually have negative charges.
sense_groups.chinese: 冰粒子通常带正电荷，雨滴通常带负电荷。

sense_groups.english: When the charges build up enough, they are discharged in a bolt of lightning , which causes the sound waves we hear as thunder.
sense_groups.chinese: 当电荷积累到足够多时，它们会以闪电的形式释放，从而产生我们听到的雷声。

sense_groups.english: On the 7th February, 2008, thunderstorms ripped through the eastern parts of Australia.
sense_groups.chinese: 2008年2月7日，雷暴席卷了澳大利亚东部地区。

sense_groups.english: Winds gusting over 90 km/hr brought down trees on houses, power lines and roads.
sense_groups.chinese: 风速超过90公里/小时的阵风将树木吹倒在房屋、电线和道路上。

sense_groups.english: The city of Perth, Western Australia had its wettest February since 1992 when more than 40 mm of heavy rain fell and caused a 50-day drought to end.
sense_groups.chinese: 西澳大利亚州珀斯市经历了自1992年以来最潮湿的二月，超过40毫米的强降雨结束了持续50天的干旱。

sense_groups.english: In its short life, the Internet has become an agent of revolutionary change
sense_groups.chinese: 在其短暂的生命中，互联网已成为革命性变革的推动者

sense_groups.english: and is one of the fastest tools to promote and defend freedom
sense_groups.chinese: 并且是促进和捍卫自由的最快工具之一

sense_groups.english: and to facilitate democratic access to information and knowledge.
sense_groups.chinese: 以及促进民主获取信息和知识。

sense_groups.english: It has emerged as one of today's greatest instruments of progress
sense_groups.chinese: 它已成为当今最伟大的进步工具之一

sense_groups.english: and has gradually become a part of the vital infrastructure of global social, economic, cultural and political life.
sense_groups.chinese: 并逐渐成为全球社会、经济、文化和政治生活关键基础设施的一部分。

sense_groups.english: The Internet's effect on our lives is pervasive.
sense_groups.chinese: 互联网对我们生活的影响是无处不在的。

sense_groups.english: Over the past decade, the use of email, the web and blogs have become part of the daily routine of more than a billion Internet users.
sense_groups.chinese: 在过去十年中，电子邮件、网络和博客的使用已成为超过十亿互联网用户日常生活的一部分。

sense_groups.english: Today the Internet access touch points have outgrown the traditional PC based Internet browsers (Internet Explorer, Firefox)
sense_groups.chinese: 如今，互联网接入点已经超越了传统的基于PC的互联网浏览器（Internet Explorer、Firefox）

sense_groups.english: to desktop applications, mobile phones and satellite navigational devices in vehicles and living rooms.
sense_groups.chinese: 扩展到桌面应用程序、手机以及车辆和客厅中的卫星导航设备。

sense_groups.english: More and more people are buying movie tickets, air tickets, travel packages, railway tickets and paying bills online.
sense_groups.chinese: 越来越多的人在线购买电影票、机票、旅行套餐、火车票并支付账单。

sense_groups.english: Online gaming is projected to increase by 141% by 2011 in the Asia Pacific Region
sense_groups.chinese: 预计到2011年，亚太地区的在线游戏将增长141%

sense_groups.english: and mobile gaming to increase by 119% by a leading gaming industry.
sense_groups.chinese: 而移动游戏将增长119%，据一家领先游戏行业预测。

sense_groups.english: Very soon we will see the dawn of the video age when video will be used for buying, communicating, learning and socializing.
sense_groups.chinese: 很快我们将迎来视频时代的黎明，届时视频将用于购物、交流、学习和社交。

sense_groups.english: Online chat and blogs are reducing the gap between private and public life of the present generation.

sense_groups.chinese: 尽管面临区域边界、版权、审查、网络封锁等反对力量。

questions.en:

sense_groups.english: Most patients with Type 2 diabetes should start taking statins, the cholesterol-fighting drugs,
sense_groups.chinese: 大多数2型糖尿病患者应该开始服用他汀类药物，即降胆固醇药物，

sense_groups.english: as a preventative measure against heart disease,
sense_groups.chinese: 作为预防心脏病的一种措施，

sense_groups.english: whether or not they have high cholesterol levels,
sense_groups.chinese: 无论他们是否胆固醇水平高，

sense_groups.english: according to new guidelines released yesterday.
sense_groups.chinese: 根据昨天发布的新指南。

sense_groups.english: The recommendations, from the American College of Physicians,
sense_groups.chinese: 这些建议来自美国内科医师学会，

sense_groups.english: call for moderate doses of statins by people with diabetes who are older than 55,
sense_groups.chinese: 要求55岁以上的糖尿病患者服用中等剂量的他汀类药物，

sense_groups.english: and for younger patients who have any other risk factor for heart disease,
sense_groups.chinese: 以及更年轻的患者，如果他们有任何其他心脏病风险因素，

sense_groups.english: like high blood pressure or a history of smoking.
sense_groups.chinese: 比如高血压或吸烟史。

sense_groups.chinese: 新指南在《内科医学年鉴》4月20日刊中概述，

sense_groups.chinese: 诊断的平均年龄是48岁，

sense_groups.chinese: 他说，甚至许多55岁以下的患者也同时患有高血压和糖尿病。

sense_groups.chinese: 通过严格控制饮食或胰岛素注射。

sense_groups.chinese: Vijan博士强调，控制高血压仍然是首要任务。

sense_groups.english: ahead of glucose regulation.
sense_groups.chinese: 优先于血糖调节。

sense_groups.chinese: 春季婚礼季已经到来，给宾客带来了高昂的花费——尤其是婚礼派对成员。

sense_groups.english: But it can be hard for twenty somethings to fit extra costs into scant budgets, especially if you have multiple weddings to attend.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以，在承诺参加仪式或成为目的地婚礼的宾客之前，一定要弄清楚你要承担什么——并寻找削减成本的方法。

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你知道自己负担不起飞往加勒比海的目的地婚礼加上迈阿密的周末新娘派对的费用，从一开始就说出来，旧金山的社交和礼仪专家苏珊·罗安妮说。

sense_groups.chinese: “公平地说‘我爱你，但如果我无法参与每一个方面，我不想让你失望，’”她说。

sense_groups.chinese: 五年后，在世界粮食峰会上，与会者决定将宣言修改为“国际消除饥饿联盟”。

sense_groups.english: Many people hope the coalition can be supported, so that a resolution will be forged and plans made to eliminate starvation and poverty.
sense_groups.chinese: 许多人希望联盟能得到支持，从而形成决议并制定计划来消除饥饿和贫困。

sense_groups.english: In 2002, during the Development Fund Raising Conference held in Monterrey, Mexico, the Grain and Agricultural Organization, International Agricultural Development Fund and World Grain Plan Department made a joint appeal for poverty elimination.
sense_groups.chinese: 2002年，在墨西哥蒙特雷举行的发展筹资会议上，粮食及农业组织、国际农业发展基金和世界粮食计划署联合呼吁消除贫困。

sense_groups.english: They also expressed dissatisfaction that governments and development partners didn't turn their promise into a detailed action plan, so there is much to be desired.
sense_groups.chinese: 他们还对政府和发展伙伴未能将承诺转化为详细行动计划表示不满，因此还有很多需要改进的地方。

sense_groups.english: At the Monterrey conference, many countries promised to increase official development aid.
sense_groups.chinese: 在蒙特雷会议上，许多国家承诺增加官方发展援助。

sense_groups.english: European Coalition countries agreed to raise the official development aid to 0.39% of the state income from 2006.
sense_groups.chinese: 欧洲联盟国家同意从2006年起将官方发展援助提高到国家收入的0.39%。

sense_groups.english: The US also announced it will increase development assistance by 5 billion US dollars in three years.
sense_groups.chinese: 美国也宣布将在三年内增加50亿美元的发展援助。

sense_groups.english: The Coalition will also keep pressure on each country to force them to honor their promises by exposing the difficult situation faced by people in starvation and poverty to the public.
sense_groups.chinese: 联盟还将持续向各国施压，通过向公众揭露饥饿和贫困人口面临的困境，迫使它们履行承诺。

答案:
1. dominate
2. false
3. expense
4. desperate
5. inevitably
6. separate

sense_groups.english: Modern wealth has been created mainly through the action of market forces, which now dominate the whole of the industrial world.
sense_groups.chinese: 现代财富主要是通过市场力量的作用创造的，现在市场力量主导着整个工业世界。

sense_groups.english: It is based on the false premise that we all start at an equal point.
sense_groups.chinese: 它基于一个错误的假设，即我们都从同一起点开始。

sense_groups.english: Of course nobody starts at the same point.
sense_groups.chinese: 当然，没有人从同一起点开始。

sense_groups.english: Market forces help a few to become very wealthy at the expense of the many who become poorer.
sense_groups.chinese: 市场力量帮助少数人变得非常富有，却以许多人变得更穷为代价。

sense_groups.english: This is taking place all over the world.
sense_groups.chinese: 这正在全世界发生。

sense_groups.english: There is an increasing number of hungry and desperate people living in utter poverty.
sense_groups.chinese: 有越来越多饥饿且绝望的人生活在极度贫困中。

sense_groups.english: Yet there are millionaires of all nationalities throughout the developed world.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，在整个发达国家，有各种国籍的百万富翁。

sense_groups.english: Market forces are inevitably acting to divide our world because they separate one section of society from another.
sense_groups.chinese: 市场力量不可避免地分裂我们的世界，因为它们将社会的一个部分与另一个部分隔离开来。

sense_groups.english: Strangely enough, to create a society based on the free play of market forces, there must be a very strict control over the economy to ensure business efficiency.
sense_groups.chinese: 奇怪的是，要创建一个基于市场力量自由运作的社会，必须对经济进行非常严格的控制以确保商业效率。

sense_groups.english: This is the poison of commercialization.
sense_groups.chinese: 这就是商业化的毒害。

sense_groups.english: It imposes restrictions on the natural needs of society.
sense_groups.chinese: 它对社会自然需求施加限制。

sense_groups.english: When the politicians are not meeting the needs of society, the people revolt.
sense_groups.chinese: 当政客们不满足社会需求时，人民就会反抗。

sense_groups.english: When the people's voice is not heard, there will inevitably be a revolution.
sense_groups.chinese: 当人民的声音不被倾听时，就不可避免地会发生革命。

sense_groups.english: Part of that revolution is the growing crime rate and the violent street protests which are the result of the imbalance of our society — too great wealth side by side with too great poverty.
sense_groups.chinese: 这场革命的一部分是不断上升的犯罪率和暴力的街头抗议，这是我们社会失衡的结果——巨大的财富与巨大的贫困并存。

sense_groups.english: Most likely a Mars mission will require transporting most of the necessary supplies and equipment by unmanned spacecraft to the chosen landing area
sense_groups.chinese: 很可能一次火星任务需要将大部分必要的补给和设备通过无人飞船运送到选定的着陆区域

sense_groups.english: and confirming their operable condition before the first astronauts even arrive.
sense_groups.chinese: 并在首批宇航员到达之前确认它们处于可操作状态。

sense_groups.english: During their long, confined stay, the Mars pioneers may live in an inflatable modular housing unit as a possible replacement for the U.S. crew quarters on the International Space Station.
sense_groups.chinese: 在漫长而受限的停留期间，火星先驱者可能居住在一个可充气的模块化住房单元中，作为国际空间站上美国船员宿舍的可能替代方案。

sense_groups.english: The cylindrical structure would be 27 ft. in diameter
sense_groups.chinese: 这个圆柱形结构的直径将为27英尺

sense_groups.english: and have a foot-thick protective shell when inflated.
sense_groups.chinese: 并且在充气后具有一英尺厚的保护外壳。

sense_groups.english: The shell would be made of almost two dozen layers of material that is stronger than steel.
sense_groups.chinese: 外壳将由近二十层比钢更坚固的材料制成。

sense_groups.english: It would also provide insulation from the extreme Martian temperatures that range from -128.3°C during the polar night to 26.6°C at the equator.
sense_groups.chinese: 它还将提供隔热，以抵御火星极端温度，范围从极夜期间的-128.3°C到赤道的26.6°C。

sense_groups.english: The module would consist of four levels, for work, health care, crew quarters, and a galley area.
sense_groups.chinese: 该模块将包含四层，分别用于工作、医疗保健、船员宿舍和厨房区域。

sense_groups.english: The space travelers will drive for miles across the planet's diverse terrain in advanced-type roving vehicles equipped with specialized tools, drills, and analytical instruments.
sense_groups.chinese: 太空旅行者将驾驶先进型漫游车穿越行星上多样化的地形数英里，这些车辆配备有专用工具、钻头和分析仪器。

sense_groups.english: Much of their time will be spent searching for water and past and present evidence of Martian life forms,

sense_groups.chinese: 并进行一系列机器人探索无法完成的科学活动。

There are few among us that did not wonder in ______ about what it would be like to be an ______ .

sense_groups.chinese: 我们中很少有人不曾敬畏地想象过成为宇航员会是什么样子。

sense_groups.english: Space exploration will forever peak humanity's interest and curiosity.
sense_groups.chinese: 太空探索将永远激发人类的兴趣和好奇心。

sense_groups.chinese: 访问外太空的殊荣属于少数骄傲的人，但随着技术的发展，越来越多的人将有机会。

sense_groups.chinese: 国际航空联合会规定，男性或女性在达到超过100英里的高度后正式成为宇航员。

sense_groups.english: As of March 30, 2006, 443 people have crossed this imaginary line.

sense_groups.chinese: 了解更多太空知识的努力很普遍。

sense_groups.chinese: 自从宇航员尤里·加加林开创性地离开我们的大气层以来，来自35个国家的男女都加入了他的行列，声名远扬。

sense_groups.english: Since the infancy of human presence in space, 18 astronauts have died on missions, and 10 more from launches .

questions.name: #50 Ever-larger Cities
questions.en: Most observers tend to extrapolate current (trends) and assume that what we see now will continue moving in the same direction — ever-larger cities, etc. I don t see it that way. The global energy predicament now gathering around us will synergize with climate change to produce a very different outcome. I think we'll eventually see a reversal of the 200-year-long cycle of people (moving) from farms and small towns to big cities. Food production is going to be a big problem when oil-and-gas-based agriculture is no longer possible, and we will have to reestablish a more (meaningful) relationship between urban places and a more productive agricultural hinterland. Our mega-cities will contract (substantially) . The fortunate ones will densify around their old cores and waterfronts — though sea level rise may affect many (harbor) cities. This process of contraction is likely to be problematic and (disorderly) .

questions.name: #51 Crimes
questions.en:
Two horrifying crimes have exposed serious ______ in Connecticut's criminal justice system.
But a "three strikes and you're out" law ______ by Gov.
M. Jodi Rell and Republicans in the Legislature would do more harm than good.
Last July two recently paroled men broke into a home in Cheshire and tortured and ______ three people.
Last month a man who served more than eight years for assaulting a 5-year-old — and had been out on ______ for less than a month — broke into a New Britain home.
He accosted two women, wounding one and killing the other.
Republicans, led by Ms. Rell, have responded by calling for a "three strikes" law.
Democrats have rightly resisted.
The proposed law, which would mandate life in prison for anyone ______ of three violent felonies, is a bumper-sticker solution that would create ______ by barring judges' discretion in sentencing.
It would also not deter the many crimes ______ by people who have not committed three violent felonies.
Governor Rell and the Democrats do agree on the need for other ______ reforms, including more re-entry programs and jobs training and better monitoring after prisoners are released on probation and parole.
Connecticut has 2,500 parolees, but a ______ 55,000 people on probation.
Probation officers handle an average of 107 cases each —far too many.
Connecticut's system for sharing crime information, which could keep some of the most dangerous offenders off the streets, is antiquated.
It has neither inpatient treatment for sex offenders nor housing for them once they are released.
Hundreds of ______ inmates are on a waiting list for inpatient drug treatment.
The suspect arrested in the New Britain case had been staying in a homeless ______ at night but roaming freely during the day while waiting to begin ______ sex offender treatment.
Returning released inmates to society with so little support makes no sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 它既没有为性犯罪者提供住院治疗，也没有为他们获释后提供住所。

sense_groups.english: Hundreds of former inmates are on a waiting list for inpatient drug treatment.
sense_groups.chinese: 数百名前囚犯正在等待住院戒毒治疗。

sense_groups.english: The suspect arrested in the New Britain case had been staying in a homeless shelter at night but roaming freely during the day while waiting to begin outpatient sex offender treatment.
sense_groups.chinese: 在纽不列颠案中被捕的嫌疑人，在等待开始门诊性犯罪者治疗期间，晚上住在无家可归者收容所，白天则自由游荡。

sense_groups.english: Returning released inmates to society with so little support makes no sense.
sense_groups.chinese: 让获释囚犯在如此少的支持下重返社会毫无意义。

questions.name: #58 Marijuana
questions.en:
There is probably no marijuana-friendlier place in the country than here in Mendocino County, where plants can grow more than 15 feet high, medical marijuana clubs adopt stretches of highway, and the sticky, sweet aroma of cannabis fills this city's streets during the autumn harvest.
Lately, however, residents of Mendocino County, like those in other parts of California, are wondering if the state's embrace of marijuana for medicinal purposes has gone too far.
Medical marijuana was ______ under state law by California voters in 1996, and since then 11 other states have followed, even though ______ law still bans the sale of any marijuana.
But some ______ residents and law enforcement officials say the California law has increasingly and unintentionally provided legal cover for large-scale marijuana growers — and the problems such as big-money operations can attract.
"It's a clear shield for commercial operations," said Mike Sweeney, 60, a supporter of both ______ marijuana and a local ballot measure on June 3 that called for new limits on the drug in Mendocino.
"And we don't want those here." The ______ of the ballot measure is not known, as votes are still being ______ , but such community push-back is increasingly common across the state, even in the most liberal communities.
In recent years, dozens of local governments have ______ or restricted cannabis clubs, more formally known as dispensaries, that provide medical marijuana to patients, in the face of ______ safety issues involved in its sale and cultivation, including crime and environmental damage.
legalized , federal , frustrated , medical , outcome , counted , banned , public
questions.answer:

2. federal
3. frustrated
4. medical
5. outcome
6. counted
7. banned
8. public

sense_groups.english: It's been a challenging decade for the music industry,

2. somewhat
3. reflections
4. attempt
5. replying

sense_groups.english: We miscommunicate more commonly than we communicate accurately .
sense_groups.chinese: 我们误解的频率比准确沟通的频率更高。

sense_groups.english: Often, the words we have are at least somewhat inadequate to express how we feel.
sense_groups.chinese: 通常，我们拥有的词语至少在一定程度上不足以表达我们的感受。

sense_groups.english: The first words we think of are often poor reflections of what we really mean.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们首先想到的词语往往无法准确反映我们的真实意思。

sense_groups.english: We might at times even want to take our words back for a second attempt .
sense_groups.chinese: 我们有时甚至想收回说过的话，再试一次。

questions.name: #62 FIB-L
questions.en:
People rarely translate another person's ______ way of saying things with any degree of ______ .

questions.full:
People rarely translate another person's ______ way of saying things with any degree of ______ .
This is because when we learn the meaning of words, we pick up their broad meaning but we've added subtle ______ of difference which we get from our personal experiences.
If you grew up in an aggressive household, the phrase 'I'm angry with you' had different ______ than for a person from a family where people talked through problems.
We're left having to work out meaning from our own experience.

unique , accuracy , shades , associations , translation

答案:
1. unique
2. accuracy
3. shades
4. associations
5. translation

sense_groups.english: People rarely translate another person's unique way of saying things with any degree of accuracy .
sense_groups.chinese: 人们很少能准确翻译另一个人独特的表达方式。

sense_groups.english: This is because when we learn the meaning of words, we pick up their broad meaning but we've added subtle shades of difference which we get from our personal experiences.
sense_groups.chinese: 这是因为当我们学习单词的含义时，我们掌握了它们的大致意思，但还加入了从个人经历中获得的细微差别。

sense_groups.english: If you grew up in an aggressive household, the phrase 'I'm angry with you' had different associations than for a person from a family where people talked through problems.
sense_groups.chinese: 如果你在一个充满攻击性的家庭长大，'我对你很生气'这个短语的含义与来自一个通过沟通解决问题的家庭的人不同。

sense_groups.english: We're left having to work out meaning from our own experience.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们只能根据自己的经验来推断含义。

sense_groups.english: So despite the fact that, say, Bob and Gina are both speaking English, Bob is really speaking 'Bob-English' and Gina is turning that into 'Gina-English' and the translation is never going to be perfect.
sense_groups.chinese: 所以，尽管鲍勃和吉娜都在说英语，但鲍勃实际上说的是'鲍勃式英语'，而吉娜将其转化为'吉娜式英语'，这种翻译永远不会完美。

sense_groups.english: Here are a couple different stories you can tell about our economy.
sense_groups.chinese: 关于我们的经济，你可以讲几个不同的故事。

sense_groups.chinese: 在我们一生中最严重的经济危机八年之后，

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的经济已经连续71个月创造了就业机会。

questions.name: #73 Online Dating

questions.name: #77 Neutron Stars
questions.en:
Last year, astronomers observed two neutron stars collide.
A crash ______ in gravitational waves to detectors here on Earth.
Represented in sound, you can hear a small upwards sweep in frequency, in the data, if you listen closely.
Several seconds later, the first waves of electromagnetic radiation arrived here on Earth - the first time a collision has been detected by both light and gravitational waves.
And it's in studying the electromagnetic ______ of the collision that astrophysicists have gotten a far better ______ of what really happened after those binary neutron stars merged, 130 million light years away.
"Oh yeah, absolutely, so it gives us an understanding of ______ all the nitty-gritty of what's going on after the merger takes place." Kunal Mooley, an astrophysicist at Caltech.
First, he says, the stars collided, creating a massive, black hole_like object, which started sucking up the cloud of neutron-rich cosmic debris left over from the crash.
But its ______ was limited.
"It cannot eat all of it, so some bit of it basically escapes." Those escaping leftovers spewed outward into space, as a powerful jet.
But along the way, Mooley says, the jet appears to have interacted with that cloud of neutron-rich material, blowing up a sort of cocoon within the debris ______ around the collision.
Until finally, the jet burst out and slammed into interstellar space releasing yet more radiation we could detect here on Earth.
transmitted , echoes , glimpse , basically , appetite , floating
questions.answer:
1. transmitted
2. echoes
3. glimpse
4. basically
5. appetite
6. floating
questions.full:
Last year, astronomers observed two neutron stars collide.

Represented in sound, you can hear a small upwards sweep in frequency, in the data, if you listen closely.
Several seconds later, the first waves of electromagnetic radiation arrived here on Earth - the first time a collision has been detected by both light and gravitational waves.
And it's in studying the electromagnetic ______ of the collision that astrophysicists have gotten a far better ______ of what really happened after those binary neutron stars merged, 130 million light years away.
"Oh yeah, absolutely, so it gives us an understanding of ______ all the nitty-gritty of what's going on after the merger takes place." Kunal Mooley, an astrophysicist at Caltech.
First, he says, the stars collided, creating a massive, black hole_like object, which started sucking up the cloud of neutron-rich cosmic debris left over from the crash.
But its ______ was limited.

But along the way, Mooley says, the jet appears to have interacted with that cloud of neutron-rich material, blowing up a sort of cocoon within the debris ______ around the collision.
Until finally, the jet burst out and slammed into interstellar space releasing yet more radiation we could detect here on Earth.

transmitted , echoes , glimpse , basically , appetite , floating

答案:

2. echoes

sense_groups.english: Last year, astronomers observed two neutron stars collide.
sense_groups.chinese: 去年，天文学家观测到两颗中子星相撞。

sense_groups.english: A crash transmitted in gravitational waves to detectors here on Earth.
sense_groups.chinese: 碰撞产生的引力波传到了地球上的探测器。

sense_groups.english: Represented in sound, you can hear a small upwards sweep in frequency, in the data, if you listen closely.
sense_groups.chinese: 用声音表示，如果你仔细听，可以在数据中听到频率的轻微上升。

sense_groups.english: Several seconds later, the first waves of electromagnetic radiation arrived here on Earth - the first time a collision has been detected by both light and gravitational waves.
sense_groups.chinese: 几秒钟后，第一波电磁辐射到达地球——这是首次同时通过光和引力波探测到碰撞。

sense_groups.chinese: 正是通过研究碰撞的电磁回波，天体物理学家才得以更清楚地了解1.3亿光年外那对中子星合并后究竟发生了什么。

sense_groups.english: "Oh yeah, absolutely, so it gives us an understanding of basically all the nitty-gritty of what's going on after the merger takes place." Kunal Mooley, an astrophysicist at Caltech.
sense_groups.chinese: “哦，是的，绝对如此，它让我们基本上了解了合并后发生的所有细节。”加州理工学院的天体物理学家库纳尔·穆利说。

sense_groups.english: First, he says, the stars collided, creating a massive, black hole_like object, which started sucking up the cloud of neutron-rich cosmic debris left over from the crash.
sense_groups.chinese: 首先，他说，恒星相撞，形成了一个巨大的类黑洞物体，开始吞噬碰撞留下的富含中子的宇宙碎片云。

sense_groups.chinese: 但它的胃口有限。

sense_groups.english: But along the way, Mooley says, the jet appears to have interacted with that cloud of neutron-rich material, blowing up a sort of cocoon within the debris floating around the collision.
sense_groups.chinese: 但穆利说，在途中，喷流似乎与那团富含中子的物质相互作用，在碰撞周围漂浮的碎片中炸开了一个茧状物。

sense_groups.english: Until finally, the jet burst out and slammed into interstellar space releasing yet more radiation we could detect here on Earth.
sense_groups.chinese: 直到最后，喷流爆发并撞击星际空间，释放出更多我们在地球上可以探测到的辐射。

questions.name: #78 Bar Code
questions.en:

The scanner then ______ this pattern into an electrical signal that the computer can understand.
All scanners must include computer software to interpret the bar code once it's been entered.

questions.full:
Many different types of bar code scanning machines exist, but they all work on the same fundamental principles.

sense_groups.chinese: 以及许多企业进行记录管理的方式。

questions.full:

sense_groups.english: Have you ever wanted to turn down the volume at a deafening concert or noisy bar?

questions.full:
Interesting sound.
I would have guessed a Wild West performer was ______ with a bullwhip while also vacuuming.

Since 2,000 researchers at Finland's Aalto University have been ______ audio, as part of what's called the Auroral Acoustics project.

But the latest results indicate that at least some sounds are produced very close to the ground.
A setup of three ground-based ______ allowed researchers to estimate that the sounds occur perhaps just 70 meters up.
The results were just presented at the International Congress on Sound and Vibration in Vilnius, Lithuania.
More information about the sounds of the northern lights could lead to a more complete understanding of the ______ .
So if you see an aurora, keep your ears open.

practicing , collecting , energetic , microphones , phenomenon

答案:
1. practicing
2. collecting
3. energetic
4. microphones
5. phenomenon

sense_groups.english: Interesting sound.
sense_groups.chinese: 有趣的声音。

sense_groups.english: I would have guessed a Wild West performer was practicing with a bullwhip while also vacuuming.
sense_groups.chinese: 我本来会猜是某个西部荒野表演者在练习甩鞭子的同时还在吸尘。

sense_groups.english: But no.
sense_groups.chinese: 但并不是。

sense_groups.english: That sound is apparently produced by the aurora borealis, the northern lights.
sense_groups.chinese: 那声音显然是由北极光产生的。

sense_groups.english: Since 2,000 researchers at Finland's Aalto University have been collecting audio, as part of what's called the Auroral Acoustics project.
sense_groups.chinese: 自2000年以来，芬兰阿尔托大学的研究人员一直在收集音频，作为所谓的极光声学项目的一部分。

sense_groups.english: Folk tales have long held that the lights also produce odd sounds, but the claims were hard to prove.
sense_groups.chinese: 民间传说一直认为极光也会产生奇怪的声音，但这些说法很难证实。

sense_groups.english: And some researchers thought that any noises produced by the energetic particles, that cause the light show would be far too high in the sky to be heard on the ground.
sense_groups.chinese: 一些研究人员认为，产生光秀的高能粒子发出的任何噪音都位于天空太高处，地面上无法听到。

sense_groups.english: But the latest results indicate that at least some sounds are produced very close to the ground.
sense_groups.chinese: 但最新结果表明，至少有些声音是在非常接近地面的地方产生的。

sense_groups.english: A setup of three ground-based microphones allowed researchers to estimate that the sounds occur perhaps just 70 meters up.
sense_groups.chinese: 一个由三个地面麦克风组成的装置使研究人员能够估计这些声音可能仅发生在70米高处。

sense_groups.english: The results were just presented at the International Congress on Sound and Vibration in Vilnius, Lithuania.
sense_groups.chinese: 这些结果刚刚在立陶宛维尔纽斯举行的国际声与振动大会上公布。

sense_groups.english: More information about the sounds of the northern lights could lead to a more complete understanding of the phenomenon.
sense_groups.chinese: 关于北极光声音的更多信息可能有助于更全面地理解这一现象。

sense_groups.english: So if you see an aurora, keep your ears open.
sense_groups.chinese: 所以，如果你看到极光，请竖起耳朵听。

sense_groups.english: The way I look back in the past is by using the fossilized remains of deep-water corals.

questions.full:
What I'm trying to understand, and what other ______ of mine are trying to understand, is how we moved from that cold climate condition to the warm climate condition that we enjoy today.
We know from ice core research that the ______ from these cold ______ to warm conditions wasn't smooth, as you might predict from the slow increase in solar radiation.

You can see those blue-white layers.

答案:

2. transition
3. conditions
4. trapped
5. temperature

sense_groups.english: What I'm trying to understand, and what other colleagues of mine are trying to understand, is how we moved from that cold climate condition to the warm climate condition that we enjoy today.
sense_groups.chinese: 我试图理解，以及我的其他同事试图理解的是，我们是如何从那种寒冷的气候条件转变到今天我们所享受的温暖气候条件的。

sense_groups.english: We know from ice core research that the transition from these cold conditions to warm conditions wasn't smooth, as you might predict from the slow increase in solar radiation.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们从冰芯研究中得知，从这些寒冷条件到温暖条件的转变并不像你可能从太阳辐射缓慢增加所预测的那样平稳。

sense_groups.english: And we know this from ice cores, because if you drill down into ice, you find annual bands of ice, and you can see this in the iceberg.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们从冰芯中得知这一点，因为如果你钻入冰层，你会发现每年的冰层，你可以在冰山上看到这一点。

sense_groups.english: You can see those blue-white layers.
sense_groups.chinese: 你可以看到那些蓝白色的层。

sense_groups.english: Gases are trapped in the ice cores, so we can measure CO2 that's why we know CO2 was lower in the past and the chemistry of the ice also tells us about temperature in the polar regions.
sense_groups.chinese: 气体被困在冰芯中，所以我们可以测量二氧化碳，这就是为什么我们知道过去二氧化碳含量较低，而冰的化学成分也告诉我们极地地区的温度。

questions.name: #120 Bee Buzz
questions.en:

"What better activity during an eclipse than to go out with a recorder and record the bees?" "So Galen asked 400 citizen scientists--including young students--to place audio recorders in 16 flower patches along the path of totality, in Oregon, Idaho and Missouri.

questions.name: #157 Coffee
questions.en:
A lot of people just don't feel quite human without that morning cup of coffee.
Now a study finds that the
enhanced sense of well-being that caffeine can cause is ______ in our perception of words.
Specifically, caffeine increases the ability to recognize words associated with positive thoughts, but doesn't provide the same ______ for words with negative or even neutral associations.
The research is in the journal PLoS One.
Scientists assigned 66 subjects to one of two groups.
Half got a 200-milligram caffeine tablet, a dose equal to almost three cups of coffee.
The other half received a sugar tablet.
Thirty minutes later the volunteers were shown strings of letters, and had to decide as fast as they could if a string formed a word or was just gibberish.
The volunteers recognized words with positive associations much faster than either negative or neutral words.
Other studies have shown that positive words tend to be recognized more quickly, but the caffeine increases the ______ .
So next time you wake up with a grumpy sweetheart, your ______ might be appreciated more if they have a cup of coffee first.
reflected , boost , gap , compliments

questions.name: #158 Global Warming
questions.en:
Global warming might seem like a botanical boon.
After all, milder temperatures and more carbon dioxide and nitrogen should feed flora.
But a ten year study has found that any ______ positive effect on plant growth from climate change may soon disappear.
The report is in the journal Nature Climate Change.
Researchers transplanted vegetation from four grassland ecosystems to lower, warmer elevations.
They also ______ the precipitation at the transplant sites based on altered rainfall estimates.
For the first year, the plants did great, producing more biomass and churning out more oxygen for us.
But their productivity went down for the rest of the ______ .
What happened?
Warming did speed up the nitrogen cycle, which should have increased nitrogen's availability as plant fertilizer.
But a lot of the nitrogen left the soil through run-off or ______ into the atmosphere.
In addition, productive native plants began to lose out to species that thrive at higher temperatures, but are less productive than the natives.
Warmer temperatures may spur immediate growth, but in the long term, we can't expect plants to like it hot.
initial , modified , decade , uptake
questions.full:
Global warming might seem like a botanical boon.
After all, milder temperatures and more carbon dioxide and nitrogen should feed flora.
But a ten year study has found that any ______ positive effect on plant growth from climate change may soon disappear.
The report is in the journal Nature Climate Change.
Researchers transplanted vegetation from four grassland ecosystems to lower, warmer elevations.
They also ______ the precipitation at the transplant sites based on altered rainfall estimates.
For the first year, the plants did great, producing more biomass and churning out more oxygen for us.

What happened?
Warming did speed up the nitrogen cycle, which should have increased nitrogen's availability as plant fertilizer.
But a lot of the nitrogen left the soil through run-off or ______ into the atmosphere.
In addition, productive native plants began to lose out to species that thrive at higher temperatures, but are less productive than the natives.
Warmer temperatures may spur immediate growth, but in the long term, we can't expect plants to like it hot.

initial , modified , decade , uptake

1. initial
2. modified
3. decade

sense_groups.english: Global warming might seem like a botanical boon.
sense_groups.chinese: 全球变暖可能看起来像是植物的福音。

sense_groups.english: After all, milder temperatures and more carbon dioxide and nitrogen should feed flora.
sense_groups.chinese: 毕竟，更温和的温度以及更多的二氧化碳和氮应该会滋养植物。

sense_groups.english: But a ten year study has found that any initial positive effect on plant growth from climate change may soon disappear.
sense_groups.chinese: 但一项为期十年的研究发现，气候变化对植物生长的任何最初积极影响可能很快就会消失。

sense_groups.english: The report is in the journal Nature Climate Change.
sense_groups.chinese: 该报告发表在《自然气候变化》期刊上。

sense_groups.english: Researchers transplanted vegetation from four grassland ecosystems to lower, warmer elevations.
sense_groups.chinese: 研究人员将来自四个草原生态系统的植被移植到更低、更温暖的海拔地区。

sense_groups.english: They also modified the precipitation at the transplant sites based on altered rainfall estimates.
sense_groups.chinese: 他们还根据改变的降雨预测调整了移植地点的降水量。

sense_groups.english: For the first year, the plants did great, producing more biomass and churning out more oxygen for us.
sense_groups.chinese: 第一年，植物表现良好，产生了更多的生物量，并为我们制造了更多的氧气。

sense_groups.english: But their productivity went down for the rest of the decade.
sense_groups.chinese: 但在接下来的十年里，它们的生产力下降了。

sense_groups.english: What happened?
sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么？

sense_groups.english: Warming did speed up the nitrogen cycle, which should have increased nitrogen's availability as plant fertilizer.
sense_groups.chinese: 变暖确实加速了氮循环，这应该会增加氮作为植物肥料的可用性。

sense_groups.english: But a lot of the nitrogen left the soil through run-off or uptake into the atmosphere.
sense_groups.chinese: 但大量的氮通过径流或吸收进入大气而离开了土壤。

sense_groups.english: In addition, productive native plants began to lose out to species that thrive at higher temperatures, but are less productive than the natives.
sense_groups.chinese: 此外，高产的本土植物开始输给那些在更高温度下茁壮成长但产量低于本土植物的物种。

sense_groups.english: Warmer temperatures may spur immediate growth, but in the long term, we can't expect plants to like it hot.
sense_groups.chinese: 更温暖的温度可能会刺激即时生长，但从长远来看，我们不能指望植物喜欢炎热。

questions.name: #160 Hormone
questions.en:
The word hormone is derived from a Greek verb that means to excite.
Hormones are found in all ______ organisms and function to coordinate the parts of the organism.
A hormone is a chemical signal.
It is produced by one part of the body and is then transported to other parts of the body where it ______ responses in cells and tissues.
The concept of chemical messengers and plants first emerged from a series of classic experiments on how plant stands respond to light.
Think about this, a houseplant on the windowsill grows toward light.
If you rotate the plant, it will soon ______ its growth until its leaves again face the window.
The growth of a plant toward light is called photo tropism .
in a forest or other natural ecosystem where plants may be crowded.
multicellular , triggers , reorient , tropism

questions.name: #161 Get-moving Plan
questions.en:
Doctors know a lot about prescribing medications.
"Take two brisk walks and call me in the morning." But for many patients, a light get-moving plan might be just what the doctor should have ______ .
Many of us aren't exactly in peak physical condition.
But a large number of people are actually deconditioned.
So says the Mayo Clinic's Michael Joyner in an essay in The Journal of Physiology.
After surgery, illness, pregnancy or extended inactivity for any reason, people might feel faint or ______ when they try even mild exercise.
These signs, Joyner argues, should be ______ by doctors not as symptoms that should be treated with drugs, but rather as a medical state of deconditioning that might be better helped with a gentle, guided ______ program.
It might sound counterintuitive that fatigue can be beat back with exercise.
But remember Newton—Isaac, not Fig.
A body at rest stays at rest.
And a body in motion needs to resist ______ forces acting upon it that might slow it down.
ordered , fatigued , recognized , exercise , external
questions.full:
Doctors know a lot about prescribing medications.
"Take two brisk walks and call me in the morning." But for many patients, a light get-moving plan might be just what the doctor should have ______ .
Many of us aren't exactly in peak physical condition.
But a large number of people are actually deconditioned.

After surgery, illness, pregnancy or extended inactivity for any reason, people might feel faint or ______ when they try even mild exercise.

It might sound counterintuitive that fatigue can be beat back with exercise.
But remember Newton—Isaac, not Fig.
A body at rest stays at rest.
And a body in motion needs to resist ______ forces acting upon it that might slow it down.

ordered , fatigued , recognized , exercise , external

答案:
1. ordered
2. fatigued
3. recognized
4. exercise
5. external

sense_groups.english: Doctors know a lot about prescribing medications.
sense_groups.chinese: 医生对开药很在行。

sense_groups.english: "Take two brisk walks and call me in the morning."
sense_groups.chinese: “快走两圈，明天早上给我打电话。”

sense_groups.english: But for many patients, a light get-moving plan might be just what the doctor should have ordered.
sense_groups.chinese: 但对很多病人来说，一个轻松的动起来计划可能正是医生应该开的处方。

sense_groups.english: Many of us aren't exactly in peak physical condition.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们很多人并非处于最佳身体状态。

sense_groups.english: But a large number of people are actually deconditioned.
sense_groups.chinese: 但很多人实际上处于失健状态。

sense_groups.english: So says the Mayo Clinic's Michael Joyner in an essay in The Journal of Physiology.
sense_groups.chinese: 梅奥诊所的迈克尔·乔伊纳在《生理学杂志》的一篇文章中这样说道。

sense_groups.english: After surgery, illness, pregnancy or extended inactivity for any reason, people might feel faint or fatigued when they try even mild exercise.
sense_groups.chinese: 在手术、疾病、怀孕或任何原因导致的长期不活动后，人们尝试轻微运动时可能会感到头晕或疲劳。

sense_groups.english: These signs, Joyner argues, should be recognized by doctors not as symptoms that should be treated with drugs, but rather as a medical state of deconditioning that might be better helped with a gentle, guided exercise program.
sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊纳认为，医生应该将这些迹象视为一种失健的医学状态，而非需要用药物治疗的症状，这种状态或许更适合通过温和的、有指导的运动计划来改善。

sense_groups.english: It might sound counterintuitive that fatigue can be beat back with exercise.
sense_groups.chinese: 用运动来对抗疲劳听起来可能违反直觉。

sense_groups.english: But remember Newton—Isaac, not Fig.
sense_groups.chinese: 但记住牛顿——艾萨克，不是菲格。

sense_groups.english: A body at rest stays at rest.
sense_groups.chinese: 静止的物体保持静止。

sense_groups.chinese: 而运动中的物体需要抵抗可能使其减速的外力。

questions.name: #162 Jack Nicholson
questions.en:
Jack Nicholson, playing the crazed caretaker in The Shining, makes me reach for a blanket .
Now a study finds that people we find, well, creepy can actually make us feel colder .
The research will be published in the journal ______ Science.
Researchers interviewed 40 college undergraduates.
During each interaction , the experimenter was either chummy with the student or very stiff and ______ .

Psychological , professional , simultaneously , receptionist

sense_groups.english: Now a study finds that people we find, well, creepy can actually make us feel colder .
sense_groups.chinese: 现在一项研究发现，那些让我们觉得毛骨悚然的人实际上会让我们感到更冷。

sense_groups.english: The research will be published in the journal Psychological Science.

sense_groups.english: Researchers interviewed 40 college undergraduates.
sense_groups.chinese: 研究人员采访了40名大学本科生。

sense_groups.chinese: 在每次互动中，实验者要么对学生很友好，要么非常生硬且专业。

questions.name: #163 Recycling

Recycling helps, but even that material has to be repulped and paperized before you can use it to print out that recipe you'll never make.
But what if you could wipe the page clean and use it again?
Light amplification by simulated emission of radiation to the rescue.
A new study shows that laser light can ______ the toner from a piece of printed paper.
The approach appears in the Proceedings of the Royal Society A. Taking a page from the art restoration handbook scientists sampled a variety of light sources to see if any could be used to strip the ink from laser printed documents without damaging or discoloring the paper.
UV and infrared were too harsh.
But a bright green laser applied in 4 nanosecond pulses vaporize the print, leaving paper that looks as good as new.
Such imprinters will probably run about 30,000 bucks, so they probably will not catch on for home use.
But people in the recycling world might find that the green laser fits the bill for making paper that’s really green.
atmosphere , erase , bill

sense_groups.english: Recycling helps, but even that material has to be repulped and paperized before you can use it to print out that recipe you'll never make.
sense_groups.chinese: 回收利用有帮助，但即使是回收材料也需要重新制浆和造纸，然后你才能用它打印出你永远不会做的食谱。

sense_groups.english: But what if you could wipe the page clean and use it again?
sense_groups.chinese: 但如果你能擦干净页面并再次使用呢？

sense_groups.english: Light amplification by simulated emission of radiation to the rescue.
sense_groups.chinese: 激光（受激辐射光放大）来救场了。

sense_groups.english: A new study shows that laser light can erase the toner from a piece of printed paper.
sense_groups.chinese: 一项新研究表明，激光可以擦除打印纸上的碳粉。

sense_groups.english: The approach appears in the Proceedings of the Royal Society A.
sense_groups.chinese: 该方法发表在《皇家学会学报A》上。

sense_groups.english: Taking a page from the art restoration handbook scientists sampled a variety of light sources to see if any could be used to strip the ink from laser printed documents without damaging or discoloring the paper.
sense_groups.chinese: 借鉴艺术修复手册，科学家们测试了多种光源，看看是否有能去除激光打印文件上的墨迹而不损坏或使纸张变色。

sense_groups.english: UV and infrared were too harsh.
sense_groups.chinese: 紫外线和红外线太强烈了。

sense_groups.english: But a bright green laser applied in 4 nanosecond pulses vaporize the print, leaving paper that looks as good as new.
sense_groups.chinese: 但一束明亮的绿色激光以4纳秒脉冲发射，能汽化打印内容，使纸张看起来像新的一样。

sense_groups.english: Such imprinters will probably run about 30,000 bucks, so they probably will not catch on for home use.
sense_groups.chinese: 这种打印机可能售价约3万美元，因此可能不会普及到家庭使用。

sense_groups.english: But people in the recycling world might find that the green laser fits the bill for making paper that’s really green.
sense_groups.chinese: 但回收行业的人可能会发现，绿色激光正好符合制造真正环保纸张的需求。

questions.name: #164 Dogs
questions.en:
Dogs are not just man’s best friend.
Previous studies have shown that kids with dogs are less likely to develop asthma.
Now a new study may show how— if results from mice apply to us.
The work was presented at a meeting of the American Society for Microbiology .
The study tests what’s called the ______ hypothesis.
The idea is that extreme cleanliness may actually promote disease later on.
Researchers collected dust from homes that had a dog.
They fed that house dust to mice.
They then infected the mice with a common ______ infection called ______ syncytial virus —or RSV.
hygiene , childhood , respiratory
questions.full:
Dogs are not just man’s best friend.
Previous studies have shown that kids with dogs are less likely to develop asthma.
Now a new study may show how— if results from mice apply to us.
The work was presented at a meeting of the American Society for Microbiology .
The study tests what’s called the ______ hypothesis.
The idea is that extreme cleanliness may actually promote disease later on.
Researchers collected dust from homes that had a dog.
They fed that house dust to mice.
They then infected the mice with a common ______ infection called ______ syncytial virus —or RSV.

hygiene , childhood , respiratory

答案:
1. hygiene
2. childhood
3. respiratory

sense_groups.english: Dogs are not just man’s best friend.
sense_groups.chinese: 狗不仅仅是人类最好的朋友。

sense_groups.english: Previous studies have shown that kids with dogs are less likely to develop asthma.
sense_groups.chinese: 先前的研究表明，养狗的孩子患哮喘的可能性更小。

sense_groups.english: Now a new study may show how— if results from mice apply to us.
sense_groups.chinese: 现在一项新研究可能揭示了其中的机制——如果老鼠的实验结果适用于人类的话。

sense_groups.english: The work was presented at a meeting of the American Society for Microbiology .
sense_groups.chinese: 这项研究在美国微生物学会的一次会议上发表。

sense_groups.english: The study tests what’s called the hygiene hypothesis.
sense_groups.chinese: 该研究验证了所谓的“卫生假说”。

sense_groups.english: The idea is that extreme cleanliness may actually promote disease later on.
sense_groups.chinese: 这个观点认为，过度清洁实际上可能在后来的生活中促进疾病的发生。

sense_groups.english: Researchers collected dust from homes that had a dog.
sense_groups.chinese: 研究人员从养狗的家庭收集了灰尘。

sense_groups.english: They fed that house dust to mice.
sense_groups.chinese: 他们将这些家庭灰尘喂给老鼠。

sense_groups.english: They then infected the mice with a common childhood infection called respiratory syncytial virus —or RSV.
sense_groups.chinese: 然后他们用一种常见的儿童感染——呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）感染了这些老鼠。

questions.name: #165 Cavemen
questions.en:
You might picture Neanderthals as cavemen gnawing on bones around a campfire, which wouldn't be ______ .
But Neanderthals may have also dined on roasted vegetables and known a bit about medicinal plants, too.
So says a study in the journal Naturwissenschaften (The Science of Nature).
Researchers ______ hardened dental plaque from five Neanderthals found in El Sidrón cave, in northern Spain.
Yes, 50,000-year-old dental plaque.
And they found a lot lurking between the teeth.
Like evidence of nuts, grasses and green veggies, ______ traces of wood smoke, and tiny, intact starch granules, proof Neanderthals ate their carbs.
And in one individual, they detected compounds found in the ______ herbs chamomile and yarrow.
The herbs have no nutritional value, and since Neanderthals did have the gene to detect the herbs' bitter taste, the researchers ______ that the cave dwellers were munching on them not as food—but to self-medicate.
Not too far-fetched, they say, because primates like chimps also use medicinal plants.
Luckily for the scientists doing this ______ work, Neanderthals may have known a thing or two about medicine, but they didn't get regular check-ups at the dentist.
inaccurate , analyzed , chemical , medicinal , speculate , detective
questions.answer:
1. inaccurate
2. analyzed
3. chemical
4. medicinal
5. speculate
6. detective
questions.full:
You might picture Neanderthals as cavemen gnawing on bones around a campfire, which wouldn't be ______ .
But Neanderthals may have also dined on roasted vegetables and known a bit about medicinal plants, too.
So says a study in the journal Naturwissenschaften (The Science of Nature).
Researchers ______ hardened dental plaque from five Neanderthals found in El Sidrón cave, in northern Spain.
Yes, 50,000-year-old dental plaque.
And they found a lot lurking between the teeth.
Like evidence of nuts, grasses and green veggies, ______ traces of wood smoke, and tiny, intact starch granules, proof Neanderthals ate their carbs.
And in one individual, they detected compounds found in the ______ herbs chamomile and yarrow.
The herbs have no nutritional value, and since Neanderthals did have the gene to detect the herbs' bitter taste, the researchers ______ that the cave dwellers were munching on them not as food—but to self-medicate.
Not too far-fetched, they say, because primates like chimps also use medicinal plants.
Luckily for the scientists doing this ______ work, Neanderthals may have known a thing or two about medicine, but they didn't get regular check-ups at the dentist.

inaccurate , analyzed , chemical , medicinal , speculate , detective

答案:
1. inaccurate
2. analyzed
3. chemical
4. medicinal
5. speculate
6. detective

sense_groups.english: You might picture Neanderthals as cavemen gnawing on bones around a campfire, which wouldn't be inaccurate .
sense_groups.chinese: 你可能会把尼安德特人想象成围着篝火啃骨头的穴居人，这倒也不算错。

sense_groups.english: But Neanderthals may have also dined on roasted vegetables and known a bit about medicinal plants, too.
sense_groups.chinese: 但尼安德特人可能也吃过烤蔬菜，并且对药用植物有所了解。

sense_groups.english: So says a study in the journal Naturwissenschaften (The Science of Nature).
sense_groups.chinese: 《自然科学》期刊上的一项研究如是说。

sense_groups.english: Researchers analyzed hardened dental plaque from five Neanderthals found in El Sidrón cave, in northern Spain.
sense_groups.chinese: 研究人员分析了西班牙北部埃尔西德龙洞穴中发现的五名尼安德特人硬化的牙菌斑。

sense_groups.english: Yes, 50,000-year-old dental plaque.
sense_groups.chinese: 没错，5万年前的牙菌斑。

sense_groups.english: And they found a lot lurking between the teeth.
sense_groups.chinese: 他们在牙齿间发现了许多隐藏的东西。

sense_groups.english: Like evidence of nuts, grasses and green veggies, chemical traces of wood smoke, and tiny, intact starch granules, proof Neanderthals ate their carbs.
sense_groups.chinese: 比如坚果、草和绿色蔬菜的证据，木烟的化学痕迹，以及微小完整的淀粉颗粒，证明尼安德特人摄入了碳水化合物。

sense_groups.english: And in one individual, they detected compounds found in the medicinal herbs chamomile and yarrow.
sense_groups.chinese: 在一个个体中，他们检测到了药用植物洋甘菊和蓍草中的化合物。

sense_groups.english: The herbs have no nutritional value, and since Neanderthals did have the gene to detect the herbs' bitter taste, the researchers speculate that the cave dwellers were munching on them not as food—but to self-medicate.
sense_groups.chinese: 这些草药没有营养价值，而且由于尼安德特人确实有检测草药苦味的基因，研究人员推测这些穴居人嚼它们不是为了食物，而是为了自我治疗。

sense_groups.english: Not too far-fetched, they say, because primates like chimps also use medicinal plants.
sense_groups.chinese: 他们说这并不牵强，因为像黑猩猩这样的灵长类动物也会使用药用植物。

sense_groups.english: Luckily for the scientists doing this detective work, Neanderthals may have known a thing or two about medicine, but they didn't get regular check-ups at the dentist.
sense_groups.chinese: 幸运的是，对于从事这项侦探工作的科学家来说，尼安德特人可能对医学略知一二，但他们不会定期去看牙医。

questions.name: #167 Mars Touchdown
questions.en:
Touchdown confirmed.
We are safe on Mars.
…… The control room at NASA’s Jet Propulsion laboratory late in the evening of August 5th, Pacific time, when word arrived that the Curiosity rover had landed safely on Mars.
The one-ton rover, which dwarfs all Mars landers that came before it, will now spend a planned two years ______ the Martian surface.
The mission is expected to cost two point five billion dollars.
Curiosity’s task is to investigate the inside of Gale Crater, where a giant mound of ______ deposits may provide evidence of a wetter, possibly habitable Mars billions of years ago.
But first it had to survive an elaborate landing ______ which appears to have gone smoothly.
Curiosity landed on time and on target and soon beamed back grainy photos of its wheels and its shadow.
Given the carlike size of the rover and the challenges of landing on Mars, Curiosity’s ______ goes down as one of the greatest parking jobs in history.
laboratory , exploring , sedimentary , sequence , landing
questions.full:
Touchdown confirmed.
We are safe on Mars.
…… The control room at NASA’s Jet Propulsion laboratory late in the evening of August 5th, Pacific time, when word arrived that the Curiosity rover had landed safely on Mars.
The one-ton rover, which dwarfs all Mars landers that came before it, will now spend a planned two years ______ the Martian surface.
The mission is expected to cost two point five billion dollars.
Curiosity’s task is to investigate the inside of Gale Crater, where a giant mound of ______ deposits may provide evidence of a wetter, possibly habitable Mars billions of years ago.
But first it had to survive an elaborate landing ______ which appears to have gone smoothly.
Curiosity landed on time and on target and soon beamed back grainy photos of its wheels and its shadow.
Given the carlike size of the rover and the challenges of landing on Mars, Curiosity’s ______ goes down as one of the greatest parking jobs in history.

laboratory , exploring , sedimentary , sequence , landing

答案:
1. exploring
2. sedimentary
3. sequence
4. landing

sense_groups.english: Touchdown confirmed.
sense_groups.chinese: 确认着陆。

sense_groups.english: We are safe on Mars.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们在火星上安全了。

sense_groups.english: …… The control room at NASA’s Jet Propulsion laboratory late in the evening of August 5th, Pacific time, when word arrived that the Curiosity rover had landed safely on Mars.
sense_groups.chinese: ……太平洋时间8月5日深夜，美国宇航局喷气推进实验室的控制室，当消息传来，好奇号火星车已安全着陆火星。

sense_groups.english: The one-ton rover, which dwarfs all Mars landers that came before it, will now spend a planned two years exploring the Martian surface.
sense_groups.chinese: 这个重达一吨的火星车，比之前所有的火星着陆器都要大，现在将按计划用两年时间探索火星表面。

sense_groups.english: The mission is expected to cost two point five billion dollars.
sense_groups.chinese: 该任务预计耗资25亿美元。

sense_groups.english: Curiosity’s task is to investigate the inside of Gale Crater, where a giant mound of sedimentary deposits may provide evidence of a wetter, possibly habitable Mars billions of years ago.
sense_groups.chinese: 好奇号的任务是调查盖尔陨石坑内部，那里巨大的沉积物堆可能提供数十亿年前火星更湿润、可能适宜居住的证据。

sense_groups.english: But first it had to survive an elaborate landing sequence which appears to have gone smoothly.
sense_groups.chinese: 但首先它必须经受住精心设计的着陆程序，这一程序似乎进行得很顺利。

sense_groups.english: Curiosity landed on time and on target and soon beamed back grainy photos of its wheels and its shadow.
sense_groups.chinese: 好奇号准时、准确地着陆，并很快传回了其轮子和阴影的模糊照片。

sense_groups.english: Given the carlike size of the rover and the challenges of landing on Mars, Curiosity’s landing goes down as one of the greatest parking jobs in history.
sense_groups.chinese: 考虑到火星车如汽车般大小以及着陆火星的挑战，好奇号的着陆堪称历史上最伟大的停车操作之一。

questions.full:

questions.name: #170 Thai Elections

sense_groups.english: Thais waited Monday for the results of an election called a return to democratic rule,
