questions.en:
The authorities in the Spanish city of Barcelona say 13 people have been killed and 80 injured by a van, which ______ drove into them at a popular tourist market.
The ______ moved at speed through Las Ramblas in the city center, before being ______ by the driver who ran away.
Hundreds of tourists and local people took shelter in shops and churches, as police searched for suspects.
Hours later, two of them, including a man of Moroccan origin, were ______ .
Spanish media say another suspect was killed in a police shootout on the outskirts of the city.
The Spanish Prime Minister, Mariano Rajoy, who is on his way to Barcelona, says he will be ______ efforts to reinforce security, while the Catalan President, Carles Puigdemont, has called for solidarity.
deliberately , vehicle , abandoned , arrested , coordinating
questions.full:
The authorities in the Spanish city of Barcelona say 13 people have been killed and 80 injured by a van, which ______ drove into them at a popular tourist market.
The ______ moved at speed through Las Ramblas in the city center, before being ______ by the driver who ran away.
Hundreds of tourists and local people took shelter in shops and churches, as police searched for suspects.
Hours later, two of them, including a man of Moroccan origin, were ______ .
Spanish media say another suspect was killed in a police shootout on the outskirts of the city.
The Spanish Prime Minister, Mariano Rajoy, who is on his way to Barcelona, says he will be ______ efforts to reinforce security, while the Catalan President, Carles Puigdemont, has called for solidarity.

deliberately , vehicle , abandoned , arrested , coordinating

答案:
1. deliberately
2. vehicle
3. abandoned
4. arrested
5. coordinating

sense_groups.english: The authorities in the Spanish city of Barcelona say 13 people have been killed and 80 injured by a van, which deliberately drove into them at a popular tourist market.
sense_groups.chinese: 西班牙巴塞罗那市当局表示，一辆货车故意冲入一个热门旅游市场，造成13人死亡，80人受伤。

sense_groups.english: The vehicle moved at speed through Las Ramblas in the city center, before being abandoned by the driver who ran away.
sense_groups.chinese: 这辆车高速穿过市中心的兰布拉大道，随后被司机弃车逃离。

sense_groups.english: Hundreds of tourists and local people took shelter in shops and churches, as police searched for suspects.
sense_groups.chinese: 数百名游客和当地人在商店和教堂避难，警方则搜捕嫌疑人。

sense_groups.english: Hours later, two of them, including a man of Moroccan origin, were arrested.
sense_groups.chinese: 几小时后，其中两人被捕，包括一名摩洛哥裔男子。

sense_groups.english: Spanish media say another suspect was killed in a police shootout on the outskirts of the city.
sense_groups.chinese: 西班牙媒体报道称，另一名嫌疑人在市郊与警方的枪战中被打死。

sense_groups.english: The Spanish Prime Minister, Mariano Rajoy, who is on his way to Barcelona, says he will be coordinating efforts to reinforce security, while the Catalan President, Carles Puigdemont, has called for solidarity.
sense_groups.chinese: 正在前往巴塞罗那的西班牙首相马里亚诺·拉霍伊表示，他将协调加强安全的工作，而加泰罗尼亚主席卡莱斯·普伊格德蒙特则呼吁团结。

questions.name: #181 Advisory Panels
questions.en:
Two former U.S. Republican presidents, George Bush Sr. and his son, George W., have called on Americans to ______ racism and anti-semitism.

reject , comments , blamed , memorial , advisory
questions.full:

reject , comments , blamed , memorial , advisory

答案:

2. blamed
3. memorial
4. advisory

sense_groups.english: Two former U.S. Republican presidents, George Bush Sr. and his son, George W., have called on Americans to reject racism and anti-semitism.
sense_groups.chinese: 两位美国前共和党总统，老布什和他的儿子小布什，呼吁美国人拒绝种族主义和反犹太主义。

sense_groups.english: It's being seen as a rebuke to Donald Trump for his comments about who was responsible for clashes in Charlotteville on Saturday.
sense_groups.chinese: 这被视为对唐纳德·特朗普的谴责，因为他评论了周六夏洛茨维尔冲突的责任方。

sense_groups.english: Mr. Trump's sparked fury when he again blamed both anti-racist protesters and white supremacists.
sense_groups.chinese: 特朗普先生再次指责反种族主义抗议者和白人至上主义者，引发了愤怒。

sense_groups.english: One demonstrator, Heather Heyer, was killed.
sense_groups.chinese: 一名示威者希瑟·海耶被杀。

sense_groups.english: At her memorial service, her mother said the killer had wanted to silence her daughter, but had ended up magnifying her.
sense_groups.chinese: 在她的追悼会上，她的母亲说凶手想让她女儿沉默，但最终却放大了她的声音。

sense_groups.english: President Trump has announced he's dismantling two advisory panels made mainly of senior business figures.
sense_groups.chinese: 特朗普总统宣布他将解散两个主要由高级商界人士组成的顾问委员会。

sense_groups.english: Several resigned in the controversy over the U.S. leader's reaction to events in Charlotteville.
sense_groups.chinese: 几位成员因美国领导人对夏洛茨维尔事件的反应引发的争议而辞职。

questions.full:
First though, family members, ______ , historians and civil rights advocates are paying tribute to Colin Powell, an American military and political leader who passed away Monday at age 84.
Powell had an ______ resume dating all the way back to his work in the Reserve Officers Training Corp while he was in college.

2. extraordinary
3. advance
4. chairman

sense_groups.english: First though, family members, politicians, historians and civil rights advocates are paying tribute to Colin Powell,
sense_groups.chinese: 首先，家庭成员、政治家、历史学家和民权倡导者正在向科林·鲍威尔致敬，

sense_groups.english: an American military and political leader who passed away Monday at age 84.
sense_groups.chinese: 他是一位美国军事和政治领袖，于周一去世，享年84岁。

sense_groups.english: Powell had an extraordinary resume dating all the way back to his work in the Reserve Officers Training Corp while he was in college.
sense_groups.chinese: 鲍威尔拥有一份非凡的履历，可以追溯到他在大学期间在预备役军官训练团的工作。

sense_groups.english: At that time, Powell had attained the ROTC's highest rank and he continued to advance his military career from there.
sense_groups.chinese: 当时，鲍威尔已经达到了ROTC的最高军衔，并从此继续推进他的军事生涯。

sense_groups.english: Powell served in combat during the Vietnam War and became a four-star general in the U.S. Army.
sense_groups.chinese: 鲍威尔在越南战争期间服役，并成为美国陆军四星上将。

sense_groups.english: During the presidency of Ronald Reagan, Powell became America's first black National Security Advisor.
sense_groups.chinese: 在罗纳德·里根总统任期内，鲍威尔成为美国第一位黑人国家安全顾问。

sense_groups.english: Under President George H.W. Bush, Powell became the first African American chairman of the U.S. Joint Chiefs of Staff,
sense_groups.chinese: 在乔治·H·W·布什总统领导下，鲍威尔成为第一位非裔美国人参谋长联席会议主席，

sense_groups.english: the country's highest ranking military officer.
sense_groups.chinese: 这是美国最高级别的军官。

questions.name: #183 Congested Ports
questions.en:
The U.S. government says it's made progress in an effort to ______ some of the shipping problems that have clogged up the international supply chain.
The government does not control that chain.
It's largely made up of ______ port operators, trucking companies, railroads and warehouses, but the Biden Administration is putting its support behind a plan for the Port of Los Angeles to ______ 24/7 and for large companies like Walmart, Home Depot and UPS to ship more goods at night.
California's Port of Los Angeles is one of the most congested ports on Earth, 40 percent of all the containers shipped to America come through here and at the Port of Long Beach.
Economic ______ and trade leaders say this is a step in the right ______ , but that it won't make a major impact in supply problems.
relieve , private , operate , analysts , direction
questions.full:
The U.S. government says it's made progress in an effort to ______ some of the shipping problems that have clogged up the international supply chain.
The government does not control that chain.
It's largely made up of ______ port operators, trucking companies, railroads and warehouses, but the Biden Administration is putting its support behind a plan for the Port of Los Angeles to ______ 24/7 and for large companies like Walmart, Home Depot and UPS to ship more goods at night.
California's Port of Los Angeles is one of the most congested ports on Earth, 40 percent of all the containers shipped to America come through here and at the Port of Long Beach.
Economic ______ and trade leaders say this is a step in the right ______ , but that it won't make a major impact in supply problems.

relieve , private , operate , analysts , direction

答案:
1. relieve
2. private
3. operate
4. analysts
5. direction

sense_groups.english: The U.S. government says it's made progress in an effort to relieve some of the shipping problems
sense_groups.chinese: 美国政府表示，在缓解一些航运问题方面取得了进展

sense_groups.english: that have clogged up the international supply chain.
sense_groups.chinese: 这些问题堵塞了国际供应链。

sense_groups.english: The government does not control that chain.
sense_groups.chinese: 政府并不控制这条供应链。

sense_groups.english: It's largely made up of private port operators, trucking companies, railroads and warehouses,
sense_groups.chinese: 它主要由私营港口运营商、卡车公司、铁路和仓库组成，

sense_groups.english: but the Biden Administration is putting its support behind a plan for the Port of Los Angeles to operate 24/7
sense_groups.chinese: 但拜登政府正在支持一项计划，让洛杉矶港全天候运营

sense_groups.english: and for large companies like Walmart, Home Depot and UPS to ship more goods at night.
sense_groups.chinese: 并让沃尔玛、家得宝和UPS等大公司在夜间运输更多货物。

sense_groups.english: California's Port of Los Angeles is one of the most congested ports on Earth,
sense_groups.chinese: 加利福尼亚州的洛杉矶港是地球上最拥堵的港口之一，

sense_groups.english: 40 percent of all the containers shipped to America come through here and at the Port of Long Beach.
sense_groups.chinese: 运往美国的所有集装箱中有40%通过这里和长滩港。

sense_groups.english: Economic analysts and trade leaders say this is a step in the right direction,
sense_groups.chinese: 经济分析师和贸易领袖表示，这是朝着正确方向迈出的一步，

sense_groups.english: but that it won't make a major impact in supply problems.
sense_groups.chinese: 但不会对供应问题产生重大影响。

questions.name: #184 Stabilization Efforts
questions.en:

The U.S. led Global Coalition to Defeat ISIS is leading ______ efforts that consolidate military gains, ______ basic essential services, and enable Syrians to voluntarily and safely return to their homes in Raqqa and other former ISIS strongholds.
Assistance includes ______ hazard and rubble removal, providing clean water, rehabilitating electricity networks, and other basic ______ .
Since April, the United States has elicited approximately $300 million in contributions and pledges from Coalition partners to support immediate stabilization and early recovery initiatives in areas liberated from ISIS in northeast Syria.
priority , stabilization , restore , explosive , necessities
questions.full:
The enduring defeat of ISIS remains a top ______ for the United States.
The U.S. led Global Coalition to Defeat ISIS is leading ______ efforts that consolidate military gains, ______ basic essential services, and enable Syrians to voluntarily and safely return to their homes in Raqqa and other former ISIS strongholds.
Assistance includes ______ hazard and rubble removal, providing clean water, rehabilitating electricity networks, and other basic ______ .
Since April, the United States has elicited approximately $300 million in contributions and pledges from Coalition partners to support immediate stabilization and early recovery initiatives in areas liberated from ISIS in northeast Syria.

priority , stabilization , restore , explosive , necessities

答案:
1. priority
2. stabilization
3. restore
4. explosive
5. necessities

sense_groups.english: The enduring defeat of ISIS remains a top priority for the United States.
sense_groups.chinese: 彻底击败伊斯兰国仍然是美国的首要任务。

sense_groups.english: The U.S. led Global Coalition to Defeat ISIS is leading stabilization efforts that consolidate military gains, restore basic essential services, and enable Syrians to voluntarily and safely return to their homes in Raqqa and other former ISIS strongholds.
sense_groups.chinese: 美国领导的全球打击伊斯兰国联盟正在领导稳定工作，巩固军事成果，恢复基本服务，并使叙利亚人能够自愿安全返回拉卡和其他前伊斯兰国据点的家园。

sense_groups.english: Assistance includes explosive hazard and rubble removal, providing clean water, rehabilitating electricity networks, and other basic necessities.
sense_groups.chinese: 援助包括清除爆炸危险和瓦砾、提供清洁水、修复电网以及其他基本必需品。

sense_groups.english: Since April, the United States has elicited approximately $300 million in contributions and pledges from Coalition partners to support immediate stabilization and early recovery initiatives in areas liberated from ISIS in northeast Syria.
sense_groups.chinese: 自4月以来，美国已从联盟伙伴那里获得约3亿美元的捐款和承诺，以支持叙利亚东北部从伊斯兰国手中解放地区的立即稳定和早期恢复计划。

questions.name: #185 Gasoline
questions.en:
Even though they usually start to ______ this time of year, the average price for a gallon of gasoline in the United States hit $3.27 this week.
That's its highest price in seven years, and it's almost double what it was last spring when roads and runways were nearly ______ because of the COVID pandemic.
There are several ______ to the price of gasoline.
The cost of getting it to gas stations, Federal and state taxes.
The cost of refining it, the ______ gas companies make, they all factor in, but the biggest chunk of what we pay, ______ for 43 percent of the cost of gasoline is the price of the crude oil gas is made from.
And not ______ , crude is also at its highest price in seven years at just over $80 per barrel.
decrease , empty , components , profits , accounting , coincidentally
questions.answer:
1. decrease
2. empty
3. components
4. profits
5. accounting
6. coincidentally
questions.full:
Even though they usually start to ______ this time of year, the average price for a gallon of gasoline in the United States hit $3.27 this week.
That's its highest price in seven years, and it's almost double what it was last spring when roads and runways were nearly ______ because of the COVID pandemic.
There are several ______ to the price of gasoline.
The cost of getting it to gas stations, Federal and state taxes.
The cost of refining it, the ______ gas companies make, they all factor in, but the biggest chunk of what we pay, ______ for 43 percent of the cost of gasoline is the price of the crude oil gas is made from.
And not ______ , crude is also at its highest price in seven years at just over $80 per barrel.

decrease , empty , components , profits , accounting , coincidentally

答案:
1. decrease
2. empty
3. components
4. profits
5. accounting
6. coincidentally

sense_groups.english: Even though they usually start to decrease this time of year,
sense_groups.chinese: 尽管它们通常每年这个时候开始下降，

sense_groups.english: the average price for a gallon of gasoline in the United States hit $3.27 this week.
sense_groups.chinese: 本周美国一加仑汽油的平均价格达到了3.27美元。

sense_groups.english: That's its highest price in seven years,
sense_groups.chinese: 这是七年来的最高价格，

sense_groups.english: and it's almost double what it was last spring when roads and runways were nearly empty because of the COVID pandemic.
sense_groups.chinese: 几乎是去年春天价格的两倍，当时由于新冠疫情，道路和跑道几乎空无一人。

sense_groups.english: There are several components to the price of gasoline.
sense_groups.chinese: 汽油价格由几个部分组成。

sense_groups.english: The cost of getting it to gas stations, Federal and state taxes.
sense_groups.chinese: 将其运送到加油站的成本、联邦和州税。

sense_groups.english: The cost of refining it, the profits gas companies make, they all factor in,
sense_groups.chinese: 提炼成本、石油公司的利润，这些都会计入其中，

sense_groups.english: but the biggest chunk of what we pay, accounting for 43 percent of the cost of gasoline, is the price of the crude oil gas is made from.
sense_groups.chinese: 但我们支付的最大部分，占汽油成本的43%，是制造汽油的原油价格。

sense_groups.english: And not coincidentally, crude is also at its highest price in seven years at just over $80 per barrel.
sense_groups.chinese: 并非巧合的是，原油价格也处于七年来的最高点，每桶略高于80美元。

questions.name: #186 Jobs Report
questions.en:
First though, the U.S. government has ______ its monthly jobs report.
It's one measure of how the economy as a whole is doing.
The report that just came out is for the month of September and it was a ______ .
Economists had ______ that 479,000 jobs would have been added last month.
The actual number was well below half that according to the U.S. Labor Department.
It was the second month in a row that the number of jobs added to the American economy was ______ lower than what economists predicted, and no one knows exactly why the growth in this area has slowed down.
Many economists point to continued concerns about the corona virus pandemic and the Delta ______ of the disease.
released , disappointment , expected , dramatically , variant
questions.full:
First though, the U.S. government has ______ its monthly jobs report.
It's one measure of how the economy as a whole is doing.
The report that just came out is for the month of September and it was a ______ .
Economists had ______ that 479,000 jobs would have been added last month.
The actual number was well below half that according to the U.S. Labor Department.
It was the second month in a row that the number of jobs added to the American economy was ______ lower than what economists predicted, and no one knows exactly why the growth in this area has slowed down.
Many economists point to continued concerns about the corona virus pandemic and the Delta ______ of the disease.

released , disappointment , expected , dramatically , variant

答案:
1. released
2. disappointment
3. expected
4. dramatically
5. variant

sense_groups.english: First though, the U.S. government has released its monthly jobs report.
sense_groups.chinese: 不过首先，美国政府发布了月度就业报告。

sense_groups.english: It's one measure of how the economy as a whole is doing.
sense_groups.chinese: 这是衡量整体经济状况的一个指标。

sense_groups.english: The report that just came out is for the month of September and it was a disappointment.
sense_groups.chinese: 刚刚发布的报告是关于九月份的，结果令人失望。

sense_groups.english: Economists had expected that 479,000 jobs would have been added last month.
sense_groups.chinese: 经济学家原本预计上个月会增加47.9万个就业岗位。

sense_groups.english: The actual number was well below half that according to the U.S. Labor Department.
sense_groups.chinese: 根据美国劳工部的数据，实际数字远低于这个数字的一半。

sense_groups.english: It was the second month in a row that the number of jobs added to the American economy was dramatically lower than what economists predicted,
sense_groups.chinese: 这已经是连续第二个月美国经济新增就业岗位数量远低于经济学家的预测，

sense_groups.english: and no one knows exactly why the growth in this area has slowed down.
sense_groups.chinese: 而且没有人确切知道为什么这一领域的增长放缓了。

sense_groups.english: Many economists point to continued concerns about the corona virus pandemic and the Delta variant of the disease.
sense_groups.chinese: 许多经济学家指出，人们对新冠疫情以及该病的德尔塔变种持续担忧。

questions.name: #187 Election Commission
questions.en:

questions.full:
Within the past few minutes, the election ______ in Kenya has declared that Tuesday’s ______ election was won by the incumbent Uhuru Kenyatta.
The opposition which has complained fraud has ______ the results.
An opposition spokesman described the process as a masquerade.
World leaders have ______ concern of the war of words between Washington and Pyongyang over North Korea’s nuclear program.
After President Trump said the US military was locked and loaded, North Korea accused him of driving the situation to the brink of nuclear war.

commission , presidential , rejected , expressed , diplomatic

答案:
1. commission
2. presidential
3. rejected
4. expressed
5. diplomatic

sense_groups.english: Within the past few minutes, the election commission in Kenya has declared that Tuesday’s presidential election was won by the incumbent Uhuru Kenyatta.
sense_groups.chinese: 在过去的几分钟里，肯尼亚选举委员会宣布，周二的总统选举由现任总统乌胡鲁·肯雅塔获胜。

sense_groups.english: The opposition which has complained fraud has rejected the results.
sense_groups.chinese: 抱怨存在欺诈的反对派已经拒绝了这一结果。

sense_groups.english: An opposition spokesman described the process as a masquerade.
sense_groups.chinese: 一位反对派发言人将这一过程描述为一场闹剧。

sense_groups.english: World leaders have expressed concern of the war of words between Washington and Pyongyang over North Korea’s nuclear program.
sense_groups.chinese: 世界领导人对华盛顿和平壤之间围绕朝鲜核计划的口水战表示担忧。

sense_groups.english: After President Trump said the US military was locked and loaded, North Korea accused him of driving the situation to the brink of nuclear war.
sense_groups.chinese: 在特朗普总统表示美军已锁定并装弹后，朝鲜指责他将局势推向核战争边缘。

sense_groups.english: Russia, China and Germany have all appealed the calm and further diplomatic efforts.
sense_groups.chinese: 俄罗斯、中国和德国都呼吁保持冷静并进一步开展外交努力。

questions.name: #188 U.S. Investment
questions.en:

questions.name: #192 Man from Future
questions.en:
In 1945, while in a state of ______ , the mathematician John von Neumann had a kind of stammering premonition.
He was in Los Alamos, working on the atom bomb, and he told his wife Klari that the “energy source” he was helping to develop would make scientists “the most hated and also the most wanted ______ of any country”.

Good biographies of some of the greatest mathematical minds are rare: because they were polymaths, biographers who can ______ their manifold achievements for the ordinary mortal are themselves thin on the ground.
This has been von Neumann’s fate, and the upshot is that he has not had the recognition he deserves.

questions.full:
In 1945, while in a state of ______ , the mathematician John von Neumann had a kind of stammering premonition.
He was in Los Alamos, working on the atom bomb, and he told his wife Klari that the “energy source” he was helping to develop would make scientists “the most hated and also the most wanted ______ of any country”.
Then he ______ her that his other ongoing project, the computer, would one day be even more important—and ______ even more dangerous.
Good biographies of some of the greatest mathematical minds are rare: because they were polymaths, biographers who can ______ their manifold achievements for the ordinary mortal are themselves thin on the ground.
This has been von Neumann’s fate, and the upshot is that he has not had the recognition he deserves.

exhaustion , citizens , informed , potentially , interpret

答案:
1. exhaustion
2. citizens
3. informed
4. potentially
5. interpret

sense_groups.english: In 1945, while in a state of exhaustion,
sense_groups.chinese: 1945年，在精疲力竭的状态下，

sense_groups.english: the mathematician John von Neumann had a kind of stammering premonition.
sense_groups.chinese: 数学家约翰·冯·诺伊曼有一种结结巴巴的预感。

sense_groups.english: He was in Los Alamos, working on the atom bomb,
sense_groups.chinese: 他在洛斯阿拉莫斯，从事原子弹的研究工作，

sense_groups.english: and he told his wife Klari that the “energy source” he was helping to develop
sense_groups.chinese: 他告诉妻子克拉里，他正在帮助开发的“能源”

sense_groups.english: would make scientists “the most hated and also the most wanted citizens of any country”.
sense_groups.chinese: 会让科学家成为“任何国家最被憎恨也最被渴求的公民”。

sense_groups.english: Then he informed her that his other ongoing project, the computer,
sense_groups.chinese: 然后他告诉她，他的另一个正在进行中的项目——计算机，

sense_groups.english: would one day be even more important—and potentially even more dangerous.
sense_groups.chinese: 有一天会变得更加重要——而且可能更加危险。

sense_groups.english: Good biographies of some of the greatest mathematical minds are rare:

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他们是博学家，

sense_groups.english: are themselves thin on the ground.
sense_groups.chinese: 本身就很少。

sense_groups.english: This has been von Neumann’s fate,
sense_groups.chinese: 这就是冯·诺伊曼的命运，

sense_groups.english: and the upshot is that he has not had the recognition he deserves.

questions.full:
Even if the distribution of women's ______ matched that of men—"if women were the doctors and men were the nurses"—she ______ that at most a third of the pay gap would disappear.
The most important cause is that women curtail their ______ as a part of a rational household response to labour markets, which generously ______ anyone, male or female, who is willing to hold down what Ms Goldin calls a "greedy job".
These are roles, such as those in law, accountancy and finance, that demand long and ______ hours.
Parents need somebody to be on-call at home in case a child falls ill and needs picking up from school, or needs cheering on at a concert or football match.

occupations , calculates , careers , reward , unpredictable

答案:
1. occupations
2. calculates
3. careers
4. reward
5. unpredictable

sense_groups.english: Even if the distribution of women's occupations matched that of men—
sense_groups.chinese: 即使女性的职业分布与男性相匹配——

sense_groups.english: "if women were the doctors and men were the nurses"—
sense_groups.chinese: “如果女性是医生，男性是护士”——

sense_groups.english: The most important cause is that women curtail their careers
sense_groups.chinese: 最重要的原因是女性缩减自己的职业生涯

sense_groups.english: as a part of a rational household response to labour markets,
sense_groups.chinese: 作为家庭对劳动力市场的理性反应的一部分，

sense_groups.chinese: 这些市场慷慨地奖励任何人，无论男女，

sense_groups.chinese: 只要他们愿意承担戈尔丁女士所说的“贪婪的工作”。

sense_groups.english: These are roles, such as those in law, accountancy and finance,
sense_groups.chinese: 这些角色，例如法律、会计和金融领域的工作，

sense_groups.chinese: 要求长时间且不可预测的工作时间。

sense_groups.chinese: 以防孩子生病需要从学校接回，

questions.full:

worries , crops , processing , amount , constitution

2. crops
3. processing
4. amount
5. constitution

sense_groups.english: Like every farmer Courtney Hammond, who grows blueberries and cranberries in Washington County, Maine, has a lot of worries .
sense_groups.chinese: 像每个农民一样，在缅因州华盛顿县种植蓝莓和蔓越莓的考特尼·哈蒙德有很多担忧。

sense_groups.english: He frets about weather, invasive species, failed crops and global prices.
sense_groups.chinese: 他担心天气、入侵物种、作物歉收和全球价格。

sense_groups.english: To abide by federal food-safety laws, he has had to do training, maintain meticulous records, have insect- and rodent-control plans and document daily the sanitation of his processing equipment.
sense_groups.chinese: 为了遵守联邦食品安全法，他必须接受培训、保持详细记录、制定虫害和鼠害控制计划，并每天记录加工设备的卫生状况。

sense_groups.english: It is a tremendous amount of work but it means, he says, "I don't have to worry about anybody getting sick from eating anything that leaves my farm."
sense_groups.chinese: 这是一项巨大的工作量，但他说，这意味着“我不必担心有人因吃了我农场出产的东西而生病。”

sense_groups.english: Now he is worried that a new law may put his hard work in jeopardy.
sense_groups.chinese: 现在他担心一项新法律可能会使他的辛勤工作陷入危险。

sense_groups.english: Earlier this month 61% of voters opted to change the state constitution to ensure that all Mainers had a "right to food", the first law of its kind in America.
sense_groups.chinese: 本月早些时候，61%的选民选择修改州宪法，以确保所有缅因州人享有“食物权”，这是美国首部此类法律。

questions.full:

sense_groups.chinese: 在2001年BBC评选最伟大词作者的投票中，列侬获得的票数是麦卡特尼的两倍多。

questions.full:

sense_groups.english: On the face of things,

Bright yellow, firm, flavorful.

2. sprayed

One day the banana is perfect.
Bright yellow, firm, flavorful.
But even within that same day brown spots appear on your perfectly ripe banana, its flesh turns mushy, and it’s destined for the compost or at best, banana bread.

The new gel can be ______ on bananas to slow the ripening process by up to 12 days.
Like other fruits bananas remain alive after being picked and it actually continues to respire.
This means that they take in oxygen and release carbon dioxide.
The more the banana ______ the faster it ripens and then rots.
Bananas ripen more quickly than most fruit because they don’t naturally slow the ______ after being picked, in fact it speeds up, causing bananas to become mushy.
Chitosan not only kills the ______ on banana’s skin that then leads to rot, it also ______ slows down the respiration in the first place.
So bananas won’t drive you bananas.

2. sprayed
3. breathes

sense_groups.english: One day the banana is perfect.
sense_groups.chinese: 有一天，香蕉是完美的。

sense_groups.english: Bright yellow, firm, flavorful.
sense_groups.chinese: 鲜黄色，坚实，味道浓郁。

sense_groups.english: But even within that same day brown spots appear on your perfectly ripe banana, its flesh turns mushy, and it’s destined for the compost or at best, banana bread.
sense_groups.chinese: 但就在同一天，你完美成熟的香蕉上出现了棕色斑点，果肉变软，它注定要进堆肥桶，或者最多做成香蕉面包。

sense_groups.chinese: 但科学家们正在开发一种方法来延长成熟香蕉的寿命。

sense_groups.english: It’s a spray-on coating made from chitosan—a substance found in crab and shrimp shells.
sense_groups.chinese: 这是一种由壳聚糖制成的喷雾涂层——壳聚糖是一种存在于蟹壳和虾壳中的物质。

questions.name: #269 Brad and Lisa
questions.en:
Brad: As I was saying, Professor Mitchell ...
Lisa: Oh, please call me Lisa.
Brad: Yes, well Lisa, well l'm still trying to get my head around the choice of (electives) for the optional part of the third-year program. I was thinking of taking personal taxation law, and company tax, together with the extra five-credit-point course on goods and services and VAT type taxes, but I'm a bit (concerned) that I'm going to pigeonhole myself too early in the course.
Lisa: Yeah, hmmm.
Brad: As you know there are going to be (interviews) for summer clerkships coming up and I really don’t want to come across as too focused on certain areas that a lot of firms don't even do, you know, have a practice in.
Lisa: Well, don't forget, um, only about 25% of the course at this stage is elective-based and you'll still have that core of subjects - crim, legal institutions, (evidence) , property law, general commercial and fed-con law, all of which would be of interest to a lot of firms. So if I were you, which I’m not, I’d really just go with what my interests are and enjoy the chance to undertake some work in an area that I'm (motivated) to pursue. Don't you think? There's an awful lot of time in this profession where you'll be undertaking long, stressful hours on projects that don't really interest you as much.

questions.name: #270 Industrial Revolution
questions.en:
The Industrial Revolution, which began in the late 18th century, marked a significant ______ in human history.

breakthrough , revolution , emergence , expansion , contributed
questions.full:
The Industrial Revolution, which began in the late 18th century, marked a significant ______ in human history.
It brought about a rapid ______ in technological advancements, leading to the mechanization of various industries.
This period witnessed the ______ of steam engines, textile mills, and the growth of urban centers.
As a result, there was a substantial ______ in the demand for labor, particularly in factories.
Workers faced harsh working conditions, long hours, and low wages, which eventually ______ to labor movements and the fight for workers' rights.

breakthrough , revolution , emergence , expansion , contributed

3. emergence

sense_groups.english: The Industrial Revolution, which began in the late 18th century,
sense_groups.chinese: 工业革命始于18世纪末，

sense_groups.english: marked a significant revolution in human history.
sense_groups.chinese: 标志着人类历史上的一次重大革命。

sense_groups.english: It brought about a rapid expansion in technological advancements,
sense_groups.chinese: 它带来了技术进步的迅速扩展，

sense_groups.english: leading to the mechanization of various industries.

sense_groups.english: This period witnessed the emergence of steam engines, textile mills,

sense_groups.chinese: 以及城市中心的增长。

sense_groups.chinese: 尤其是在工厂中。

questions.name: #272 Impact of Climate Change

One of the most effective ways to reduce greenhouse gas emissions is to transition to renewable sources of energy, such as solar and wind power.

In the face of this global challenge, cooperation and ______ action are crucial to safeguarding our planet for future generations.

evident , changing , proactive , conservation , collective

答案:
1. evident
2. changing
3. proactive
4. conservation
5. collective

sense_groups.english: The impact of climate change on our planet is becoming increasingly evident .
sense_groups.chinese: 气候变化对我们星球的影响正变得越来越明显。

sense_groups.english: Rising temperatures, more frequent extreme weather events, and melting glaciers are just a few of the signs that our climate is changing .
sense_groups.chinese: 气温上升、极端天气事件更频繁以及冰川融化，只是我们气候正在变化的几个迹象。

sense_groups.english: To combat this crisis, it is essential for individuals, communities, and governments to take proactive actions.
sense_groups.chinese: 为了应对这场危机，个人、社区和政府采取积极主动的行动至关重要。

sense_groups.english: One of the most effective ways to reduce greenhouse gas emissions is to transition to renewable sources of energy, such as solar and wind power.
sense_groups.chinese: 减少温室气体排放的最有效方法之一，是转向太阳能和风能等可再生能源。

sense_groups.english: Additionally, conservation efforts, like reforestation and protecting endangered species, can help maintain the balance of our ecosystems.
sense_groups.chinese: 此外，像重新造林和保护濒危物种这样的保护努力，有助于维持我们生态系统的平衡。

sense_groups.english: In the face of this global challenge, cooperation and collective action are crucial to safeguarding our planet for future generations.
sense_groups.chinese: 面对这一全球性挑战，合作和集体行动对于保护我们的地球、造福子孙后代至关重要。

sense_groups.english: Art is a reflection of human expression .

sense_groups.chinese: 它采取多种形式，从绘画和雕塑等视觉艺术到舞蹈和戏剧等表演艺术。

sense_groups.chinese: 艺术具有激励、挑战和引发思考的力量，使其成为我们生活中不可或缺的一部分。

questions.full:

2. magnetism
3. hierarchy
4. level
5. operating

sense_groups.english: So, what is quantum mechanics?
sense_groups.chinese: 那么，什么是量子力学？

sense_groups.english: Even though it was discovered by physicists,
sense_groups.chinese: 尽管它是由物理学家发现的，

sense_groups.english: it's not a physical theory in the same sense as electromagnetism or general relativity.
sense_groups.chinese: 但它并不是像电磁学或广义相对论那样的物理理论。

sense_groups.english: In the usual "hierarchy of sciences" -- with biology at the top, then chemistry, then physics, then maths --
sense_groups.chinese: 在通常的“科学层级”中——生物学在最上层，然后是化学、物理学，再是数学——

sense_groups.chinese: 量子力学处于数学和物理学之间的一个层次，我不知道该给它起什么好名字。

sense_groups.chinese: 基本上，量子力学是其他物理理论作为应用软件运行的操作系统，

sense_groups.english: (with the exception of general relativity, which hasn't yet been successfully ported to this particular OS).
sense_groups.chinese: （除了广义相对论，它尚未被成功移植到这个特定的操作系统上）。

sense_groups.chinese: 这些网站让你输入症状，然后给出诊断。

sense_groups.english: They're also better than some untrained humans.
sense_groups.chinese: 它们也比一些未经训练的人类更好。

sense_groups.chinese: 诚信意味着即使在小事上也要信守承诺。

sense_groups.english: One day, they made a discovery of ancient words in a library book,
sense_groups.chinese: 一天，他们在图书馆的一本书中发现了一些古老的文字，

sense_groups.english: which inspired the whole class.
sense_groups.chinese: 这激励了全班同学。

sense_groups.english: They realized that honest actions together with shared responsibilities
sense_groups.chinese: 他们意识到，诚实的行动加上共同的责任

sense_groups.english: can shape a brighter future.
sense_groups.chinese: 可以塑造更光明的未来。
